programme.title: 自訂台灣軼晴
programme.desc: Day 3日程：1.早餐; 2.體能挑戰; 3.水豚咖啡室; 4.神秘驚喜; D：今日Candy好勁，玩體能挑戰過到好多關卡，不愧為運動員！C：今日所有行程我都好滿意，做運動可以流汗又有挑戰性，同埋今日個神秘驚奇真係令我意想不到，多謝製造驚喜畀我嘅咁多位.

programme.title: 單車踩爆日本 -捉鬼單車隊-境港
programme.desc: 蘇皓兒 (Chloe) 及陳安立 (Brian) 單車踩爆完和歌山轉戰鳥取！今集佢哋兩個被「鬼」揞眼指使下，從好友變競爭對手爭奪鬼太郎送出的終極大獎。呼風喚雨嘅好勝女神玩到濕晒身，勝負終局神鬼難測.

programme.title: P1X3L 5G 上位計劃
programme.desc: 本集，P1X3L 5G以及十位踢館嘉賓，將進行Airtime爭奪戰，每人將獲得專屬Airtime，只要在遊戲中落敗，或違反製作組設下的「潛規則」，會被扣減時間，當時間歸零，要接受「臉堅尼」大懲罰。誰能在遊戲中獲勝，生存到最後？被戴上「臉堅尼」的落敗者，又能否在最後的追逐戰中，將所有人變成同類.

programme.title: FWD 富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB
programme.desc: 本集邀請周國賢擔任嘉賓，以「岔路」為主題，唱出面對人生走到分岔路口時，需要面對的壓力與限制，與大家探討「人生」－－一段充滿曲折與變幻的旅程。本集亦邀請到Mike 曾比特帶來歌曲《雪出個未來》，樂迷切勿錯過！本集亦繼續會有 「CHILL CLUB 推介榜」，與樂迷一同公布本週第一至第十位推介歌曲.

programme.title: 手尋藝術
programme.desc: 跨媒介藝術家馮捲雪想透過木刻與繪畫，建構一個屬於2084年的未來世界。今集，主持除了帶大家欣賞她充滿想像力的作品，更會學習木刻技巧、用木顏色做出漸變效果.

programme.title: 日本GAO芯假期
programme.desc: 在大阪已超過兩星期，芯駖和Gao走訪多個值得推介的景點，渡過了輕鬆愉快的假期。一天，她們收到特別驚喜，邀請到東京的秘密派對！去秘密派對前，二人去了體驗武士流。盛裝的二人帶著緊張的心情到達派對地點.

programme.title: 廚神奶奶是你媽
programme.sub-title: 積分賽第五回合 + 決賽
programme.desc: 第五回合積分賽繼續，其中一個問題問到奶奶平時如何稱呼新抱，黎碧芬 (Peggy) 原來一直私下叫新抱江若琳 (Elanne) 做 Ling Ling，但兒子蕭唯展 (Oscar) 和 Elanne 都表示完全沒有聽過，場面十分搞笑。綜合第四、第五回合，郭玥彤 (Celia) 和奶奶梁綺芳 (Connie) 暫時領先。為了準備決賽，3對婆媳連日不斷練習，Celia 老公李冠鋒 (阿鋒) 更表示：「聞到味都想嘔」。阿姨組決定用「6299家傳餃子」和「茄子卷」迎戰；Celia 組就用「菠蘿咕嚕肉」和「芝士龍蝦伊麵」比賽；Elanne 和 Peggy 就用「蟠龍鱔」和「花膠髮菜金蠔」迎戰。終於到決賽當日，節目組請來名廚周中師傅、亞洲女廚神 May Chow 和練美娟（娟姐）作為評判，Connie 更指與周中師傅有一面之緣，當年Connie 參加廚藝比賽，而當時周中師傅也是評判之一，十分有緣.

programme.title: 全運港將 第25集 -攀岩 - 陳翔志 黃卓楠
programme.desc: 在攀岩項目中，速度攀登是最刺激、競爭最激烈的一個項目，選手們通過不斷練習，希望打破自己的個人最佳時間.

programme.title: 熊熊幫幫團 2
programme.desc: 《熊熊幫幫團 2》講述了大寶二寶和利華組成的「熊熊幫幫團」幫助小朋友解決困難和煩惱的故事。 著重展現孩子們樂於助人、勇敢團結、智慧耐心、富有正義責任等美好成長品格，延續了溫暖、正義、輕鬆、愉快的故事風格。自從上部「熊熊幫幫團」組成後，已經為小鎮居民做了許多好事。 每當響起求助的警報，俏皮的團子、勇敢的大寶、可愛的二寶、機智的利華便會開啟絢麗的魔法通道，第一時間出現在需要幫助的人面前，他們活躍在小鎮和 森林四處，利用奇妙的魔法、聰明的頭腦、趣味的科技發明幫助大家，成為了森林小鎮的守護者，也成為了大家信賴的援手和正面榜樣。 但是，「熊熊幫幫團」即將面臨更多更大的挑戰！ 在幫忙、救援的過程中，他們將會碰到更多性格迥異、有著不同習慣的小朋友，還將遇到各種前所未有的困難和煩惱，「熊熊幫幫團」又會如何幫助大家解決 問題呢.

programme.title: 世界之「趣」
programme.desc: 正所謂「世界之大無奇不有」！在這千奇百趣的世界裡，當中集合了許多有趣歷史和文化，不知你又認識幾多呢？就讓「AI導遊」考考你，與大家一起探索世界，成為「世界百科小博士」.

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界.

programme.title: 幾廿歲人搞邊科？
programme.sub-title: 馮素波 娛樂圈長青樹
programme.desc: 年近 80 歲的馮素波（大家熟悉的「貼地嫲嫲」），可說是娛樂圈活著最具代表性的長青樹之一。她從40歲開始飾演老角，至今演過的角色不勝其數，但在芸芸角色中，她最喜歡的老人家還是「現在的自己」。就在 80 歲這個重要的時刻，她選擇推出自己的書籍和個人演唱會，向大家展現她充沛的創造力和活力。她認為，勇於接受每一個新的挑戰是不分年齡的，只要有心去做，什麼事情都是可能的.

programme.title: 本周快閃人口
programme.desc: 「本周快閃人口」是一個讓觀眾感受一個另類旅遊的節目，我們將跟隨不同身份的人一同度過一個非凡的周末。這些人包括寵物店的買手、劍擊運動員的家長等等，他們每個人都有自己獨特的放假方式。他們的周末有別於一般人留在香港，而是選擇到海外渡過，當中有人因為偶像，也有人因為減壓而飛到外地。我將跟隨受訪者的「快閃」假期機會深入了解他們，並體驗他們所經歷的獨特周末。每個受訪者以兩集為單位透過主持人的視角，感受到不同人的生活方式觀察他們的在「快閃」當中的苦樂。同時受訪者也會帶領主持人去一些平日常去的地方，例如他們喜歡的咖啡店、偶像應援活動、比賽活動等.

programme.title: 寶礦力水特電解質水 ion water 呈獻: 週六好戲勢: 不日成婚
programme.desc: 阿佳 (陳家樂 飾) 與可怡 (衛詩雅 飾) 在一個婚禮上相識，兩人一拍即合，相愛五年，終於迎來最大的感情危機－「結婚」！女方視結婚為愛的證明；男方視結婚為愛的墳墓，二人在這議題上互有攻守，展開了一場男女之間深層次的角力！可怡的閨蜜Jenny (談善言 飾) 與Jessica (楊偲泳 飾) 出謀獻策，教她以鋼管舞及Cosplay之術，嘗試引誘阿佳進入圈套，務求在沒有安全措施之下一擊即中！一旦懷孕，婚事不就勢在必行？！阿佳眼見可怡對自己展開「逼婚計劃」，惟有在兄弟灰熊 (朱栢康 飾) 與阿健 (岑珈其 飾) 的幫忙下積極迎戰，誓要堅守不婚底線！女方計謀被連番識破，Jessica只好掏出殺著－春藥！得知消息的灰熊冒著生命危險通風報信，阿佳雖已有所防範，但還是百密一疏，中了可怡的圈套，渡過了極爽快的「無套一夜」！事後阿佳提心吊膽，最反對結婚的浪子阿健立即提出「事後大行動」— 務求在黃金三十六小時內，將事後避孕丸偷偷讓可怡服下！然而，阿佳冷靜過後，還是打消了念頭，但事情最終敗露。阿佳百口莫辯，可怡心灰意冷，決絕提出分手。回復單身的二人心境大不相同，可怡在姐妹的陪伴下走出陰霾，重新出發，將生活的重心放回自身，重拾Working Holiday的心願。那邊廂阿佳自以為瀟灑，盡情享受單身的自由，但隨時間推移卻愈發空虛難耐，此時他才明白相比於面對婚姻，他更恐懼的，原來是永遠失去可怡！為追回即將飛往他國的女友，他當機立斷，誓要策劃一場「不日成婚」大行動.

programme.title: 殭屍100～在成為殭屍前要做的100件事～
婚前試行為
programme.desc: 5位準新娘正式出嫁，接新娘過程笑料百出！5對新人輪流拍攝特色結婚相，騎呢鬼馬！期後各新人上台致辭，感動落淚。有人更突然變掛，宣布押後婚事！最後陳柏宇獻唱，為大家送上祝福，為節目寫下句號.

programme.title: 究竟讀緊乜
programme.sub-title: 誰是外語天才最後贏家
programme.desc: 上集一杯伏特加令肥仔外語能力爆升，考試高分領先第一，今集ERROR繼續學習歐洲語系，先來幾句飲啤酒必講德文壯膽；隨即學浪漫法文識女仔，問電話號碼；最後學西班牙文點菜。Dee哥終於在第二回合踏出第一步，有力挑戰肥仔位置。究竟邊位成員可以獲得大獎？上完課，為對讀大學有更多體驗，ERROR約了兩位美女工讀生，親自到訪了解他們課後的打工生活.

programme.title: 返歸啦俄仔
programme.desc: 久別重逢的兩母子，一齊去旅行，媽媽緊係好緊張啦！今集嚟到索契，媽媽第一時間帶Ansheles同 Ceci做個索契最出名的Spa。聽講要浸落啲黑色嘅坑渠水度！咁咪好臭?係享受定係要人難受呀？之後Ansheles同Ceci仲去咗索契嘅Local Market買手信，試食最奇型怪狀嘅俄羅斯小食。食到樣都變埋，俄羅斯啲小食可能真係要戰鬥民族先岩食啦.

programme.title: 勁騎26
programme.desc: 第一集感受完男人味重嘅電單車，今集 Alton 點解會出現喺 café 飲咖啡？電單車除咗「型」，原來仲有「溫柔」？史上最「治癒」嘅大場面，令 Alton 超驚喜，甚至鏡頭前向 Lokman 炫耀！係咩驅使 Alton 幫人泊車？又係咩驅使佢喺馬路上「暴走」？係愛同責任啊.

programme.title: 廚神奶奶是你媽
programme.sub-title: 積分賽第五回合 + 決賽
programme.desc: 第五回合積分賽繼續，其中一個問題問到奶奶平時如何稱呼新抱，黎碧芬 (Peggy) 原來一直私下叫新抱江若琳 (Elanne) 做 Ling Ling，但兒子蕭唯展 (Oscar) 和 Elanne 都表示完全沒有聽過，場面十分搞笑。綜合第四、第五回合，郭玥彤 (Celia) 和奶奶梁綺芳 (Connie) 暫時領先。為了準備決賽，3對婆媳連日不斷練習，Celia 老公李冠鋒 (阿鋒) 更表示：「聞到味都想嘔」。阿姨組決定用「6299家傳餃子」和「茄子卷」迎戰；Celia 組就用「菠蘿咕嚕肉」和「芝士龍蝦伊麵」比賽；Elanne 和 Peggy 就用「蟠龍鱔」和「花膠髮菜金蠔」迎戰。終於到決賽當日，節目組請來名廚周中師傅、亞洲女廚神 May Chow 和練美娟（娟姐）作為評判，Connie 更指與周中師傅有一面之緣，當年Connie 參加廚藝比賽，而當時周中師傅也是評判之一，十分有緣.

programme.title: 狗仔隊亂入Seoul
programme.desc: Kathy和Dixon前往首爾會合狗狗主持Teddy，Teddy盡地主之誼，帶領二人到櫻花秘點散步；為了深入認識這位狗拍檔，二人約會Teddy主人，對方竟然是香港人？因為神祕力量令Dixon犬化，他必須前往弘大狗狗咖啡廳尋找解決辦法.

programme.title: 文藝誌
programme.desc: 「藝術」兩個字，意義卻有千百種解釋，總給予人「離地」的感覺。為了令藝術的形象「貼地」，節目「踩場」到不同的文藝團體，透過「傾閒偈」，並互動「過招」，幫觀眾了解該藝團的有趣好玩之處。同時，節目會拜見最新穎到最傳統的藝團，探索出文藝的脈絡，幫大家對「文藝」二字下新定義.

programme.title: 菁新力量
programme.desc: 曾贏得世界角色扮演高峰會香港區冠軍的高淑敏，以正職養活興趣，每日只睡四小時，用熱愛編織夢想。今集主持將帶大家發掘這位Coser背後不為人知的點點滴滴.

programme.title: 環保發現號
programme.desc: 膠類物品回收後，究竟有什麼用處？今集主持訪問膠類回收公司創辦人，看看他們在這方面有什麼新見解.

programme.title: 執屋
programme.desc: 今集《執屋》的屋主Patrick是一個專欄作家及電影發燒友，家中堆滿電影周邊產品、影展紀念品，多到有盆栽枯去多時都全然不知！而當收藏品全部都是充滿回憶的東西，Patrick為每件物品的去留不斷掙扎的時候，執屋大師阿橙，小占與Kathy仔又會如何解決這個難題呢.

programme.title: 異國風情畫
programme.desc: 三子將對台灣的思念一下子發洩了出來之後，便按慣例嚐嚐台式傳統菜以及逛逛夜市掃街。他們亦嘗試展示自己藝術的天分：吹玻璃.

programme.title: GO！執！事務所
programme.desc: 上集講到GO! 執! 事務所成員去到連鎖美容集團的辦公地點進行任務，難關到關比一關多，整理 IT 部貨存時令三名成員大呼救命。在整理茶水間之時，更發現 疫情前的史前遺物... 四位執事更要以猜拳決定執行地獄任務..

programme.title: 老友記實用手冊
programme.desc: 運動不分年齡，步行足球為長者帶來全新的健康生活方式。本集邀請步行足球教練，分享這項新興運動的魅力，如何讓長者享受運動的樂趣，同時保持身心活力.

programme.title: 雙線運動人生
programme.desc: 許晴，香港閃避球代表隊資深成員，參與多屆亞洲錦標賽、世界錦標賽等國際賽事。許晴積極推廣閃避球，組織賽事、培訓青少年，面對無專屬場地等挑戰仍堅持訓練，展現熱血與專業精神.

programme.title: Bandai 呈獻: No.1戰隊五獸者
學界Create, Like and Share 第三季
programme.desc: 全新充滿創意與活力的節目《學界Create, Like and Share》， 帶領觀眾深入探索香港各大學校的獨特魅力和多彩生活! 節目不僅聚焦學校的學術成就，更展現學生們的創意才華與日常趣事，讓觀眾感受到校園的創意與活力。每集節目中，校園導遊瑪姬邀請不同學校的學生團隊，展示他們的創意項目、藝術表演及社會服務，令觀眾更加了解學校！你可以透過這個節目一探學校的多樣性，發掘你未曾想過學校的有趣一面.

programme.title: 返學啦老豆
programme.desc: 陳子豐今次上小一編程班，終於重拾自信！在小息時和同學仔玩包剪搥，想不到很受小學生歡迎！而陳柏宇就初嚐出名難食的學校飯盒，同學仔叫他不要有任何期望，百厭的 Jason 又買了一盒叉燒「加料」，同學仔會喜歡嗎.

programme.title: Bandai 呈獻: 幪面超人 ZEZTZ
聲畫合拍 8
programme.desc: 《Stille Nacht》講述在未來，人類因失去生育能力而發明模擬人類Norah。他們只能一直工作直至銷毀，如果擅離職守，便會被殺手處決。平安夜，兩名殺手奉命追殺一名Norah，然而簡單的差事卻意外頻出⋯⋯本集邀請到編導及演員上來分享創作理念.

programme.title: 雲端對談 第四系列
programme.desc: 香港企業家，合和實業創辦人及現任主席。1958年畢業於美國普林斯頓大學，獲土木工程學士學位。代表作是位於香港灣仔的合和中心。於上世紀八十至九十年代積極於內地興建公路及電廠助力內地改革開放，包括廣州中國大酒店、廣深高速公路、廣珠高速公路、虎門大橋、沙角電廠等.

programme.title: 為食家族
programme.desc: 經過自助餐後，四組為食家族候選人順利選出，他們接下來的挑戰就是飲茶。飲茶是香港人的傳統飲食文化之一。而作為為食家族相信都會有不少跟家人一起飲茶的機會。今集，四組家族將會進行首次跟飲茶有關的比賽，到底四隊家族對他們隊中長輩的飲食喜惡有多了解？每次飲茶都會點的必食點心究竟是什麼？今集從遊戲中看出彼此之間的了解程度有幾深.

programme.title: 山旮旯拯救隊
programme.desc: 這次山旮旯拯救隊的AV跟狄達來到了山旮旯中的山旮旯，遠在台灣外島的金門烈嶼鄉，這次的地方創生案例是由一位返鄉青年陳家揚所發起的，AV與狄達首先到了烈嶼鄉的西方街拜訪陳家揚，跟陳家揚聊聊當初為什麼會毅然決然返鄉開始進行地方創生，並認識了陳家揚進行地方創生社區營造的西方社區.

programme.title: 癮營人
programme.desc: 入營必做的事：講鬼故！Ame說自己見到靈體，附近就有靈體聽她講故事，她亦善用塔羅牌，試過問牌而不聽指引，換來壞結果，從此，她更相信自己的靈力，她說感應到部份房間有異像；STEM Sir和Ame相反，會用科學或數據解釋種種異像，又追問Ame和靈體相關的問題。中途，傳來尖叫聲，Thomas又失踪，舍監嘉盈、許賢叫大家分組找尋人間凶器，發現有些癮營人很迷信，有些很理性.

programme.title: 巴絲Let’s go歐
programme.sub-title: 整葡撻變咗相睇? 問答大賽考驗193兄妹
programme.desc: 去得葡萄牙，193同細妹郭嘉盈（Michelle）當然要試吓親自製作葡撻，點知整葡撻會變成193想將細妹嫁入豪門嘅契機？坐完里斯本著名嘅電車，兩兄妹要進行巴絲常識問答大賽，你就會知道佢哋有幾咁「了解」對方.

programme.title: 我哋都係香港人
programme.desc: 在香港土生土長的孟加拉裔少女Lamia，畢業於港大讀犯罪學及美國文化研究，在2019年被推薦加入政府的諮詢委員會。在疫情期間眼見很多視障人士外出不便，就與友人開設AI智能眼睛，更贏社創基金，幫忙更多香港的視障人士.

programme.title: 也文也武同學仔
programme.desc: 同學仔在校園生活真的多姿多彩，就好像位於將軍澳的迦密主恩中學。這裡的同學仔除了可以成為英文大使、成班同學演出話劇、發揮創意研發科技、還可以玩非撞式欖球添.

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界.

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 專題式深入報道香港及世界熱門時事.

programme.title: Gen Z觀察學
programme.desc: Gen Z這詞至今應該並不陌生，這一代在智能手機面世後才出生的這群年輕人在龐大網絡資訊量的環境下成長，會否變得實際不再愛做夢？還是更愛活在自己世界裏，只沉醉於自己的夢？更重要的是，他們的夢，究竟是什麼？將來的世界是屬於他們的，他們又如何看待這個世界？如何用他們的長處來幫到自己、幫到他人、甚至幫到這個世界？世界對他們許多的標籤，有讚許的，但更多是質疑，究竟當中幾多成真幾成是偏見？ 社會卻很愛輕易地一句：「代溝」就形容了兩代關係，但其實connect 可以來得很輕易。今次節目主旨就是一部將觀眾嘅價值觀由上一代穿越到這一代的時光機，由Gen X代表強尼、Gen Y代表練美娟同Gen Z代表 Boris 來一個三代同堂，帶大家進入00後腦洞大開的世界，了解新世代的價值觀，並將這些00後進行有趣的大配對，發揮他們的強項，幫助自己、幫助對方，以及幫助更多的人。跟大家一起上一堂《GenZ觀察學》.

programme.title: 細事都被你看透
programme.desc: 「網上起人底！係彰顯正義定陷人於不義？」「關愛座冇人座，你坐咗係咪錯？」網上熱話無奇不有，而且浮現了奇異現象；事件即使雞毛蒜皮，談論總是樂此不疲，題材趣怪貼地，回應自然舖天蓋地，隨時比大新聞更轟動。全新訪談節目，將會透過不同藝人、專家及講者，從多角度分析每日最hit話題，娛樂民生，衣食住行，無所不談。話題看似事不關己，實際影響其實殺到埋身！未雨绸缪，不再食花生，捍衛立場，舌劍唇槍，一於「小題大做」！濕碎嘢，認真傾，集大成，看世情.

programme.title: 德國寶入伙專家呈獻: 24小時健身俱樂部

programme.title: UA 亞洲聯合財務呈獻: 戀愛等高線

programme.title: foodpanda呈獻: 馬力十足賀新年
programme.desc: 主持化身馬仔勇闖「行運競技祭」，爭取服侍行運馬仔的榮耀！更挑戰「舞獅 x 街舞」的大膽組合，掀起一場傳統與潮流碰撞的「舞林大會」.

programme.title: 晚吹 - 男人亂講嘢
programme.desc: 世界覺醒（WOKE）了，每天都變得更像彩虹更有活力！從來以為自己是世界中心的男人卻呆站原地，眼光光看著日換星移宇宙萬變，看似固步自封但其實是有心無力！為舒緩廣大香港男士因為社會價值急速變化產生的焦慮和不安，三字頭的193（郭嘉駿）、四字頭的阿Thor（駱振偉）、以及五字頭的灘叔（鄒凱光）每星期都會圍爐亂講一通︰講男人求偶、男人私怨、男人包袱、男人浪漫、男人衰嘢、男人保健、男人蠢事——女觀眾或會恥笑，但男觀眾一定會感動大笑！就此召喚迷途的新時代男性，同《男人亂講嘢》一齊尋找當下世界觀，刷新固有價值觀，重塑男人三十、四十、五十路的人生觀！今次唔係要話人知男人曾經有幾威，而係要探討宜家男人有幾閉翳.

programme.title: 足球女將

programme.desc: 第八集迎來第二次表白的高潮時刻。孝良與 Maya 提早出發前往彩虹山，眾人早已察覺表白意圖，卻普遍看淡結果。風雪中，孝良勇敢表白，並當眾拋棄前度戒指，情感真摯卻未獲回應，引發其他人潸然淚下。節目末尾的告別晚宴上，有人借歌寄意，再次表達心意，氣氛尷尬微妙。秘魯旅程就此畫下句點，戀愛等高線進入全新篇章.

programme.title: foodpanda呈獻: 馬力十足賀新年
programme.desc: 年初二車公誕，主持兵分兩路跟住「九宮飛星圖」跑勻全港！由出海釣魚、馬寶道掃街、馬料水求姻緣，鬥快衝線沙田車公廟！邊隊率先上頭炷香，搶到車公加持好運馬年.

programme.title: 德國寶入伙專家呈獻: 晚吹 - 空肚講宵夜
programme.desc: 年~又過年~快睇宵夜團年~ 空肚講宵夜又同大家過新年！今年一齊食住宵夜開年！阿祖邀請佢認識嘅外國朋友上節目分享當地新年飲食文化。今年唔再打牌，轉玩外國新年傳統遊戲.

programme.title: 3 分鐘熱度
programme.desc: 娛樂資訊節目《3分鐘熱度》是ViuTV一個自家製作，集娛樂圈消息及熱話的精華式娛樂資訊節目，以明快節奏、幽默角度報道本港及海外演藝界最新動態，快而準追蹤娛樂圈消息.

programme.title: MIRROR TIME
programme.desc: 幾位 MIRROR 成員來到 Philip Island，一嘗在賽道上賽車飛馳的樂趣，感受當中的刺激；「願望輪盤」首次登場，成員需要玩遊戲爭奪實現願望的機會.

programme.title: 我的青春
programme.desc: 講述宋仲基飾演的角色本來是一位童星，長大後變成小說家和花店老闆。當他與娛樂公司經理人（千瑀嬉飾）相遇後，在人生中發生了意想不到的轉變，他們曾在少年時代的困難時期互相慰藉，如今命運將他們再次交織在一起，將埋藏已久的記憶喚醒，迫使他們面對以為已經放下的情感.

programme.title: 花書生熱愛史
programme.desc: 劇情講述打破所有固定觀念的寄宿家庭「二花院客棧」的主人尹端午和懷有祕密的寄宿生花書生三人幫。四位青春演繹的清新無邪的神祕浪漫喜劇史劇.

programme.title: 犬系戀人
programme.desc: 《犬系戀人》講述高中老師韓海娜，某天喝醉酒後，不小心吻了同事陳書元，因而啟動家族詛咒，讓韓海娜一到淩晨就會變成小狗。而變回來的方法，就是要再親一次陳書元。但不幸的是，陳書元不僅極度悶騷害羞，還非常害怕狗狗！為了破解詛咒，韓海娜決定開始和陳書元變成朋友，進而拉近關係。​.

programme.title: 有生之年
programme.desc: 《有生之年》以「高家一家人」為核心，故事由異鄉遊子高嘉岳（吳慷仁 飾）一句「我回來了」揭開序幕。高嘉岳感情、事業雙雙卡關，打算與世界告別之前，回家探望家人，沒想到卻發現每一個人都活得不如他預期。​.

programme.title: 百次的回憶
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在1980年代，講述100號巴士「車掌小姐」（乘務員）「煐禮」與「悰喜」的閨蜜情。「悰喜」將與「煐禮」一起奔馳在100號巴士上，用她的獨立與灑脫，書寫屬於80年代女孩的故事。她們更會與命中注定的男子在青春歲月中交織一場青澀愛戀.

programme.desc: 劇情講述打破所有固定觀念的寄宿家庭「二花院客棧」的主人尹端午和懷有祕密的寄宿生花書生三人幫。四位青春演繹的清新無邪的神祕浪漫喜劇史劇.

programme.title: 犬系戀人
programme.desc: 《犬系戀人》講述高中老師韓海娜，某天喝醉酒後，不小心吻了同事陳書元，因而啟動家族詛咒，讓韓海娜一到淩晨就會變成小狗。而變回來的方法，就是要再親一次陳書元。但不幸的是，陳書元不僅極度悶騷害羞，還非常害怕狗狗！為了破解詛咒，韓海娜決定開始和陳書元變成朋友，進而拉近關係。​.

programme.title: 有生之年
programme.desc: 《有生之年》以「高家一家人」為核心，故事由異鄉遊子高嘉岳（吳慷仁 飾）一句「我回來了」揭開序幕。高嘉岳感情、事業雙雙卡關，打算與世界告別之前，回家探望家人，沒想到卻發現每一個人都活得不如他預期。​.

programme.title: 百次的回憶
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在1980年代，講述100號巴士「車掌小姐」（乘務員）「煐禮」與「悰喜」的閨蜜情。「悰喜」將與「煐禮」一起奔馳在100號巴士上，用她的獨立與灑脫，書寫屬於80年代女孩的故事。她們更會與命中注定的男子在青春歲月中交織一場青澀愛戀.

programme.title: 我的青春
programme.desc: 講述宋仲基飾演的角色本來是一位童星，長大後變成小說家和花店老闆。當他與娛樂公司經理人（千瑀嬉飾）相遇後，在人生中發生了意想不到的轉變，他們曾在少年時代的困難時期互相慰藉，如今命運將他們再次交織在一起，將埋藏已久的記憶喚醒，迫使他們面對以為已經放下的情感.

programme.title: 美女與純情男
programme.desc: 此劇敘述年幼便出道養家的一線女演員與PD的愛情故事。女演員因母親賭博的債務及醜聞一夜之間跌落谷底。PD嘗試鼓勵她重新振作，女演員卻消失了….

programme.title: 百次的回憶
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在1980年代，講述100號巴士「車掌小姐」（乘務員）「煐禮」與「悰喜」的閨蜜情。「悰喜」將與「煐禮」一起奔馳在100號巴士上，用她的獨立與灑脫，書寫屬於80年代女孩的故事。她們更會與命中注定的男子在青春歲月中交織一場青澀愛戀.

programme.title: 醫師阿修羅
programme.desc: 女急救醫生杏野朱羅(松本若菜)有著出色的醫療技術，甚至能夠同時為兩名重症患者進行高難度手術，以致被稱為「阿修羅醫生」，她從不考慮醫院的利益，亦不會顧忌上級，只會專注拯救眼前的患者，即使對方身無分文又或者是黑道成員，都堅信要絕對幫助他們.

programme.title: 幸福的婚姻
programme.desc: 幸太郎命中註定的戀人－一位私立高中的美術教師涅盧拉曾在研究所學習修復學，畢業後前往意大利留學。回國後，她持續從事繪畫修復等相關工作，但因某個事件轉行成為美術教師。她平常不輕易流露情感，幾乎不展現笑容，卻擁有足以徹底改變幸太郎（阿部貞夫）婚姻觀念的神秘魅力。\\r\\n描述貫徹獨身主義50年的精英律師原田幸太郎，生活一直理性而有序，直到與涅盧拉命運般的邂逅後閃婚。婚後他逐漸發現，妻子隱藏著一個巨大的秘密，使得他原本平穩的生活走向意想不到的方向.

programme.title: ONE DAY~平安夜的騷動~
programme.desc: 故事講述二宮和也飾演的勝呂寺誠司，在平安夜驚醒於山下碼頭，發現眼前有具被射殺的屍體。他成了最大嫌疑人，卻對發生的一切沒有任何回憶。此時他遇上了廚師立葵時生，並要嘗試從回憶碎片中尋找破案線索。​.

programme.title: 戀愛是黑暗
programme.desc: 故事從東京發生的一連串慘烈連環殺人案展開，而案件現場讓兩名記者的命運交織在一起。設樂浩暉（志尊淳）是週刊雜誌的知名自由撰稿人，筒井萬琴則是電視台新聞節目導播（岸井雪乃），敏銳且富有正義感。兩人因追蹤同一起案件而相識，並在攜手調查的過程中逐漸被彼此吸引。然而，隨著調查的深入，浩暉的身分卻越來越可疑，他的過去與案件的關聯也逐漸浮出水面──他，究竟是無辜的旁觀者，還是那個令人聞風喪膽的連環殺人犯.

programme.title: 幸福的婚姻
programme.desc: 幸太郎命中註定的戀人－一位私立高中的美術教師涅盧拉曾在研究所學習修復學，畢業後前往意大利留學。回國後，她持續從事繪畫修復等相關工作，但因某個事件轉行成為美術教師。她平常不輕易流露情感，幾乎不展現笑容，卻擁有足以徹底改變幸太郎（阿部貞夫）婚姻觀念的神秘魅力。\\r\\n描述貫徹獨身主義50年的精英律師原田幸太郎，生活一直理性而有序，直到與涅盧拉命運般的邂逅後閃婚。婚後他逐漸發現，妻子隱藏著一個巨大的秘密，使得他原本平穩的生活走向意想不到的方向.

programme.title: BLUE MOMENT
programme.desc: 晴原柑九朗作為SDM本部首席代表兼氣象研究員利用智慧與知識，冒著生命危險站在最前線，保護人們的性命免受巨大氣象災害威脅，為使命奮鬥的故事。​.

programme.desc: 故事從東京發生的一連串慘烈連環殺人案展開，而案件現場讓兩名記者的命運交織在一起。設樂浩暉（志尊淳）是週刊雜誌的知名自由撰稿人，筒井萬琴則是電視台新聞節目導播（岸井雪乃），敏銳且富有正義感。兩人因追蹤同一起案件而相識，並在攜手調查的過程中逐漸被彼此吸引。然而，隨著調查的深入，浩暉的身分卻越來越可疑，他的過去與案件的關聯也逐漸浮出水面──他，究竟是無辜的旁觀者，還是那個令人聞風喪膽的連環殺人犯.

programme.title: 幸福的婚姻
programme.desc: 幸太郎命中註定的戀人－一位私立高中的美術教師涅盧拉曾在研究所學習修復學，畢業後前往意大利留學。回國後，她持續從事繪畫修復等相關工作，但因某個事件轉行成為美術教師。她平常不輕易流露情感，幾乎不展現笑容，卻擁有足以徹底改變幸太郎（阿部貞夫）婚姻觀念的神秘魅力。\\r\\n描述貫徹獨身主義50年的精英律師原田幸太郎，生活一直理性而有序，直到與涅盧拉命運般的邂逅後閃婚。婚後他逐漸發現，妻子隱藏著一個巨大的秘密，使得他原本平穩的生活走向意想不到的方向.

programme.title: 有生之年
programme.desc: 《有生之年》以「高家一家人」為核心，故事由異鄉遊子高嘉岳（吳慷仁 飾）一句「我回來了」揭開序幕。高嘉岳感情、事業雙雙卡關，打算與世界告別之前，回家探望家人，沒想到卻發現每一個人都活得不如他預期。​.

programme.title: 百次的回憶
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在1980年代，講述100號巴士「車掌小姐」（乘務員）「煐禮」與「悰喜」的閨蜜情。「悰喜」將與「煐禮」一起奔馳在100號巴士上，用她的獨立與灑脫，書寫屬於80年代女孩的故事。她們更會與命中注定的男子在青春歲月中交織一場青澀愛戀.

programme.title: 我的青春
programme.desc: 講述宋仲基飾演的角色本來是一位童星，長大後變成小說家和花店老闆。當他與娛樂公司經理人（千瑀嬉飾）相遇後，在人生中發生了意想不到的轉變，他們曾在少年時代的困難時期互相慰藉，如今命運將他們再次交織在一起，將埋藏已久的記憶喚醒，迫使他們面對以為已經放下的情感.

programme.title: 花書生熱愛史
programme.desc: 劇情講述打破所有固定觀念的寄宿家庭「二花院客棧」的主人尹端午和懷有祕密的寄宿生花書生三人幫。四位青春演繹的清新無邪的神祕浪漫喜劇史劇.

programme.title: 犬系戀人
programme.desc: 《犬系戀人》講述高中老師韓海娜，某天喝醉酒後，不小心吻了同事陳書元，因而啟動家族詛咒，讓韓海娜一到淩晨就會變成小狗。而變回來的方法，就是要再親一次陳書元。但不幸的是，陳書元不僅極度悶騷害羞，還非常害怕狗狗！為了破解詛咒，韓海娜決定開始和陳書元變成朋友，進而拉近關係。​.

programme.desc: 講述宋仲基飾演的角色本來是一位童星，長大後變成小說家和花店老闆。當他與娛樂公司經理人（千瑀嬉飾）相遇後，在人生中發生了意想不到的轉變，他們曾在少年時代的困難時期互相慰藉，如今命運將他們再次交織在一起，將埋藏已久的記憶喚醒，迫使他們面對以為已經放下的情感.

programme.title: 花書生熱愛史
programme.desc: 劇情講述打破所有固定觀念的寄宿家庭「二花院客棧」的主人尹端午和懷有祕密的寄宿生花書生三人幫。四位青春演繹的清新無邪的神祕浪漫喜劇史劇.

programme.title: 犬系戀人
programme.desc: 《犬系戀人》講述高中老師韓海娜，某天喝醉酒後，不小心吻了同事陳書元，因而啟動家族詛咒，讓韓海娜一到淩晨就會變成小狗。而變回來的方法，就是要再親一次陳書元。但不幸的是，陳書元不僅極度悶騷害羞，還非常害怕狗狗！為了破解詛咒，韓海娜決定開始和陳書元變成朋友，進而拉近關係。​.

programme.title: 有生之年
programme.desc: 《有生之年》以「高家一家人」為核心，故事由異鄉遊子高嘉岳（吳慷仁 飾）一句「我回來了」揭開序幕。高嘉岳感情、事業雙雙卡關，打算與世界告別之前，回家探望家人，沒想到卻發現每一個人都活得不如他預期。​.

programme.title: 申社長Project
programme.desc: 申在浩是深受愛戴的炸雞餐廳老闆，卻擁有異於常人的膽識與協商技巧，他擅長幫助他人解決糾紛。雖然他行事低調，但他的智慧和熱情卻為他贏得了鄰裡中「非正式調解員」的美譽。申在浩在幫助別人的同時發現自己過去埋藏的傷痛.

programme.title: 花書生熱愛史
programme.desc: 劇情講述打破所有固定觀念的寄宿家庭「二花院客棧」的主人尹端午和懷有祕密的寄宿生花書生三人幫。四位青春演繹的清新無邪的神祕浪漫喜劇史劇.

programme.title: 長安十二時辰
programme.desc: 《長安十二時辰》改編自馬伯庸的同名小説，講述了唐朝上元節前夕，長安城陷入危局，長安死囚張小敬臨危受命，與李必攜手在十二時辰內拯救長安的故事.

programme.title: 斛珠夫人
programme.desc: 浩瀚的九州大地上，大徵朝珠賦沉重，逼得漁民絞殺親子，以謀鮫女落淚而得鮫珠，沿海漁村的少女海市（楊冪飾）因此遭遇，父母亡故，全村被屠戮。生死關頭，她求助於途經此地的大徵第一權臣方諸（陳偉霆飾演），歷經考驗，最終被方諸帶回天啟。海市從此女扮男裝，成為方諸的徒弟。此時，大徵內憂外患不斷，喜怒不定的年輕皇帝褚仲旭（徐開騁飾），因為經受皇朝內亂，而對生失去了一切興趣，表面上以昏君自居，卻在方諸苦苦支撐國家和平時，暗中默默觀望這一切.

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.

programme.title: 長安十二時辰
programme.desc: 《長安十二時辰》改編自馬伯庸的同名小説，講述了唐朝上元節前夕，長安城陷入危局，長安死囚張小敬臨危受命，與李必攜手在十二時辰內拯救長安的故事.

programme.title: 周生如故
programme.desc: 《周生如故》根據墨寶非寶原著小說《一生一世美人骨》古代篇改編，講述了坐擁數十萬大軍的異姓王爺小南辰王與清河漼氏正支唯一獨女，未來的太子妃漼時宜之間的虐戀故事.

programme.title: 斛珠夫人
programme.desc: 浩瀚的九州大地上，大徵朝珠賦沉重，逼得漁民絞殺親子，以謀鮫女落淚而得鮫珠，沿海漁村的少女海市（楊冪飾）因此遭遇，父母亡故，全村被屠戮。生死關頭，她求助於途經此地的大徵第一權臣方諸（陳偉霆飾演），歷經考驗，最終被方諸帶回天啟。海市從此女扮男裝，成為方諸的徒弟。此時，大徵內憂外患不斷，喜怒不定的年輕皇帝褚仲旭（徐開騁飾），因為經受皇朝內亂，而對生失去了一切興趣，表面上以昏君自居，卻在方諸苦苦支撐國家和平時，暗中默默觀望這一切.

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.title: 長安十二時辰
programme.desc: 《長安十二時辰》改編自馬伯庸的同名小説，講述了唐朝上元節前夕，長安城陷入危局，長安死囚張小敬臨危受命，與李必攜手在十二時辰內拯救長安的故事.

programme.title: 我的人間煙火
programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.

programme.title: 長安十二時辰
programme.desc: 《長安十二時辰》改編自馬伯庸的同名小説，講述了唐朝上元節前夕，長安城陷入危局，長安死囚張小敬臨危受命，與李必攜手在十二時辰內拯救長安的故事.

programme.title: 俗女養成記（原音版）
programme.desc: 39歲的陳嘉玲沒房沒車沒老公沒小孩，還丟了工作，正式加入女魯蛇(loser)的行列。當年不惜引發家庭革命也決心要離開家鄉的她，在台北奮鬥了近二十年，到頭來是一場空。她不知道接下來的路要怎麼走，但她告訴自己，接下來的每一天至少可以不違感受，平凡但誠實，普通但理直氣壯的往前走，做一個接受自己的「俗女」.

programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.

programme.title: 夏花
programme.desc: 本劇以患病少女何冉在生命最後階段學習生活、情感經歷與個人成長為線，講述她在遇到有著難以釋懷過往、幾乎對未來人生失去信心的傑出園藝家蕭寒後，兩人經過一系列誤打誤撞的、溫馨浪漫的奇妙際遇後，從彼此身上尋回各自生命中最重要卻曾經缺失的部分，重拾對生活的信心和希望，也收穫刻骨銘心愛情的故事.

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.title: 我的人間煙火
programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.title: 愛很美味
programme.desc: 《愛很美味》講述了三位個性迥異、特色鮮明的都市麗人，在經歷了一系列創業的艱辛，職場的壓迫，和感情的波折後，對生活、事業和愛情都有了重新的認識.

programme.title: 今夜一起為愛鼓掌
programme.desc: 佳晨（楊謹華 飾）是一名很會做愛的性治療師，但仍不知道怎麼愛人。圖書館員青語（Ella陳嘉樺 飾）有著外人羨慕的婚姻和工作，卻無法跟老公阿哲做愛。一個不能做愛的女人、和一個很會做愛的女人，當她們逐漸勇於面對自我，揭開過往傷疤；在探索性的旅程中，找到愛的救贖.

programme.title: 愛很美味
programme.desc: 《愛很美味》講述了三位個性迥異、特色鮮明的都市麗人，在經歷了一系列創業的艱辛，職場的壓迫，和感情的波折後，對生活、事業和愛情都有了重新的認識.

programme.title: 仿生人間
programme.desc: 2035年，與人類形象無異的仿生人由於發展過快，引發公眾的擔憂。“明眸”組織專門負責仿生人案件，組員程諾頭腦冷靜，安秋善於共情，面對仿生人不斷被害，兩人聯手揭開謎團。眾生煙火，仿生人間。人類和仿生人的命運都正在被悄悄改寫.....

programme.title: 俗女養成記（原音版）
programme.desc: 39歲的陳嘉玲沒房沒車沒老公沒小孩，還丟了工作，正式加入女魯蛇(loser)的行列。當年不惜引發家庭革命也決心要離開家鄉的她，在台北奮鬥了近二十年，到頭來是一場空。她不知道接下來的路要怎麼走，但她告訴自己，接下來的每一天至少可以不違感受，平凡但誠實，普通但理直氣壯的往前走，做一個接受自己的「俗女」.

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.

programme.title: 長安十二時辰
programme.desc: 《長安十二時辰》改編自馬伯庸的同名小説，講述了唐朝上元節前夕，長安城陷入危局，長安死囚張小敬臨危受命，與李必攜手在十二時辰內拯救長安的故事.

programme.title: 周生如故
programme.desc: 《周生如故》根據墨寶非寶原著小說《一生一世美人骨》古代篇改編，講述了坐擁數十萬大軍的異姓王爺小南辰王與清河漼氏正支唯一獨女，未來的太子妃漼時宜之間的虐戀故事.

programme.title: 斛珠夫人
programme.desc: 浩瀚的九州大地上，大徵朝珠賦沉重，逼得漁民絞殺親子，以謀鮫女落淚而得鮫珠，沿海漁村的少女海市（楊冪飾）因此遭遇，父母亡故，全村被屠戮。生死關頭，她求助於途經此地的大徵第一權臣方諸（陳偉霆飾演），歷經考驗，最終被方諸帶回天啟。海市從此女扮男裝，成為方諸的徒弟。此時，大徵內憂外患不斷，喜怒不定的年輕皇帝褚仲旭（徐開騁飾），因為經受皇朝內亂，而對生失去了一切興趣，表面上以昏君自居，卻在方諸苦苦支撐國家和平時，暗中默默觀望這一切.

programme.desc: 浩瀚的九州大地上，大徵朝珠賦沉重，逼得漁民絞殺親子，以謀鮫女落淚而得鮫珠，沿海漁村的少女海市（楊冪飾）因此遭遇，父母亡故，全村被屠戮。生死關頭，她求助於途經此地的大徵第一權臣方諸（陳偉霆飾演），歷經考驗，最終被方諸帶回天啟。海市從此女扮男裝，成為方諸的徒弟。此時，大徵內憂外患不斷，喜怒不定的年輕皇帝褚仲旭（徐開騁飾），因為經受皇朝內亂，而對生失去了一切興趣，表面上以昏君自居，卻在方諸苦苦支撐國家和平時，暗中默默觀望這一切.

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.

programme.title: 我的人間煙火
programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.title: 長安十二時辰
programme.desc: 《長安十二時辰》改編自馬伯庸的同名小説，講述了唐朝上元節前夕，長安城陷入危局，長安死囚張小敬臨危受命，與李必攜手在十二時辰內拯救長安的故事.

programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.

programme.title: 長安十二時辰
programme.desc: 《長安十二時辰》改編自馬伯庸的同名小説，講述了唐朝上元節前夕，長安城陷入危局，長安死囚張小敬臨危受命，與李必攜手在十二時辰內拯救長安的故事.

programme.title: 了不起! 舞社 第二季
programme.desc: 聚焦「齊舞」體裁，除了“元老”贊多、程瀟回歸，還邀請了楊丞琳、鄭秀妍、高瀚宇、李斯丹妮加盟主理人與原生廠牌組成6支全新的明星限定組合，共同創作不同風格的齊舞作品，通過數輪競技和淘汰，聯合征戰為尊嚴battle到底，爭奪最終的「年度最佳廠牌」榮譽.

programme.title: 一起露營吧 第二季
programme.sub-title: 感受熱情似火的桃花節
programme.desc: 潮流露營全面升級，發起人陳偉霆將帶領魏大勛、王琳凱、楊迪、尹正、張顏齊組成「露」人團，他們將邀請5組不同社交關系的飛行好友團展開社交露營，在5個夢幻營地完成5次主題露營，構建5種理想生活畫像，共赴自然美好.

programme.title: 我們戰鬥吧
programme.desc: 六位高顏值男星組成男神戰隊，兩位隊長井柏然、王凱和隊員蕭敬騰、王嘉爾、楊爍、白敬亭通過神秘人提供的重要作戰資訊，合力完成高空冒險、密室探索、極限越野等各種高難度任務挑戰.

programme.title: 海昏行 第1季
programme.desc: 講述現代失意青年王衡意外穿越到西漢，結識了神似前女友的俠女得九，並與性格開朗的王爺劉賀成為摯友；他們試圖憑藉王衡的現代思維與知識，聯手改變劉賀悲劇性的命運，並在過程中共同成長、療愈彼此.

programme.title: 婢女
programme.desc: 講述國公府庶女沈玉清因生母被害，被迫替嫡姐與攝政王裴寂成婚。她化名媚香樓伎女夕顏接近裴寂，暗中揭露國公府與太后勾結的陰謀，同時保護自己的孩子裴昭。二人在對抗敵對勢力過程中歷經生死，最終裴寂假死脫身，與隱居民間的夕顏母子團聚.

programme.title: 一站到底
programme.desc: 《一站到底》升級進入競速時代，答題拼速度，輸贏靠積分! 選手對決人數由10人變為8人，首度開啟搶答模式，除站位獎外再增豐富答題連擊獎，連續守擂三期的選手更有機會獲得高薪工作機會.

programme.title: 了不起! 舞社 第二季
programme.sub-title: 程瀟跳恐怖版《小白船》嚇壞贊多
programme.desc: 聚焦「齊舞」體裁，除了“元老”贊多、程瀟回歸，還邀請了楊丞琳、鄭秀妍、高瀚宇、李斯丹妮加盟主理人與原生廠牌組成6支全新的明星限定組合，共同創作不同風格的齊舞作品，通過數輪競技和淘汰，聯合征戰為尊嚴battle到底，爭奪最終的「年度最佳廠牌」榮譽.

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃 第2季
programme.sub-title: 周深挑戰電子爵士風格
programme.desc: 將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台.

programme.title: 約見名醫

programme.title: 非來不可
programme.desc: 邀請了兩位博學幽默的大叔孟非、劉震雲老友相聚，攜手“忘年交”新朋友張顏齊、李雅娟，展開代際碰撞的「交換遊學」，互相體驗對方的旅行玩法，他們將依次去往呼倫貝爾、成都、南京、昆山、大理等地，邀非見不可之人，去非來不可之地.

programme.title: 可愛的旅行
programme.desc: 以寵物為主角，萌寵們在「鏟屎官」的帶領下，前往上海、大理、深圳三座城市，從城市到田園，從森林到海邊，讓觀眾看到人寵相伴的多樣出行方式，了解到流浪動物的救助計劃，以及探索人與寵物的和諧相處的新方法.

programme.title: 偏愛之戀

programme.desc: 22位單身男女為愛而來，隻身抵達遠離都市的荒野之境，展開為期14天的偏愛之戀旅程；當生存競技撞上戀愛修羅場，淘汰危機和情感抉擇之下，一場麫包與玫瑰的較量即將展開，他們能否找到屬於自己的愛與偏愛.

programme.desc: 第四季繼續火熱來襲，保留「親家宣言」環節，以最短時間展現家風面貌。在激烈的代際碰撞中，促進父母與子女的溝通；在形形色色的故事背後，引發大眾的情感共鳴.

programme.title: 盒子裡的貓
programme.desc: 全明星沉浸式劇情體驗綜藝；圍繞遊戲、喜劇兩大元素，以社會熱點話題為創作基礎，打造不同遊戲主題。一個盒子空間，一群神秘玩家，他們需要在各種離奇、爆笑和反轉中，一步步揭開故事真相，走出盒子，體驗一場專屬的心靈療愈之旅.

programme.title: 吃在江蘇
programme.desc: 從蘇派美食的風味、特點出發，講述南北飲食的差異和地域性，將人對美食的創造和情感與江蘇的飲食文化緊密結合，呈現蘇派美食的獨有魅力.

programme.title: 我是隱藏款
programme.sub-title: 高瀚宇正式確診雙商為零
programme.desc: 30組新銳潮玩設計師帶著自己的原創IP，與高瀚宇、何廣智、賴美雲、謝可寅、周揚青、周震南組成3組潮玩工作室，經歷一系列主題創作，在創意與設計中不斷挑戰自我、團結協作，用繪畫表達語言，賦予這些潮流新興IP更具生命力的藝術價值，也讓更多「隱藏款」原創IP和寶藏設計師被看到.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾
programme.desc: 突破傳統的交友方式，24位單身女生以亮燈和滅燈方式來決定男嘉賓去留，通過「愛之初體驗」、「愛之再判斷」、「愛之終決選」、「男生權利」等決定男女嘉賓的速配成功.

programme.title: 全力以赴的行動派 第二季
programme.desc: 由黃明昊、哈妮克孜、李宏毅、秦霄賢、趙小棠等嘉賓組成「探玩行動派」，以全新升級的劇情式玩法解鎖城市新風貌；他們將以最年輕、最活力的方式穿越各大城市，發揮創新的思維，創造出全新的有趣玩法.

programme.desc: 講述現代失意青年王衡意外穿越到西漢，結識了神似前女友的俠女得九，並與性格開朗的王爺劉賀成為摯友；他們試圖憑藉王衡的現代思維與知識，聯手改變劉賀悲劇性的命運，並在過程中共同成長、療愈彼此.

programme.title: 婢女
programme.desc: 講述國公府庶女沈玉清因生母被害，被迫替嫡姐與攝政王裴寂成婚。她化名媚香樓伎女夕顏接近裴寂，暗中揭露國公府與太后勾結的陰謀，同時保護自己的孩子裴昭。二人在對抗敵對勢力過程中歷經生死，最終裴寂假死脫身，與隱居民間的夕顏母子團聚.

programme.title: 嗨！唱起來
programme.desc: 全新互動音樂節目，以「星素結合」的形式全民共唱。100位素人歌手將通過現場K歌贏得機會成為三位幸運歌手，與每集的大咖歌手進行合唱挑戰，實現自己的夢想。大咖歌手嘉賓包括孫楠、羽泉等.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾 第16季
programme.sub-title: 探討愛情裡的示弱與關心

programme.title: 音浪合夥人
programme.desc: 蘇有朋、薛之謙、王嘉爾、周筆暢、胡彥斌、歐陽娜娜等明星作為音浪召集人，他們將與300位合夥人組成3組音浪團，在24小時內緊急排練，一起完成創意十足的音樂SHOW.

programme.title: 我們的歌 第六季
programme.sub-title: 騰格爾龔琳娜再現神級舞台
programme.desc: 節目煥新升級，打破原有賽制，以「聽世界的聲音，唱我們的歌」為主題，廣邀了劉宇寧、毛不易、馬嘉祺、古巨基、李克勤、騰格爾、龔琳娜等三十多位歌手平行演繹，回歸音樂本質，共同打造融合金曲，為歌手之間的合作與交流提供更多的可能性，打造充滿無限活力的音樂盛宴.

programme.title: 戀戀不忘的我們
programme.desc: 10位渴望愛情的單身男女共同入住「戀戀小屋」，他們中某些人將與意難平的前任重逢，重新審視自己的感情需求，探索與前任復合或開啟新戀情的可能性，在愛與成長、遺憾與釋懷的交織中，尋找理想愛情歸宿.

programme.title: 非來不可 第3季
programme.desc: 以「山河即課堂，行走即成長」為主題，由何廣智、劉奕君、李雅娟、孫藝洲、楊超越組成的「非來游學團」踏入內蒙古的草原、沙漠、礦洞與峽谷，完成了一場真實、鮮活、不設腳本的人文探索，開啟一場兼具治愈感與知識性的旅程.

programme.sub-title: 搶歌大戰 首演舞台驚豔亮相

programme.title: 傳承人 第三季

One night at the bar district, Jae-hee discovers the other side of Heung-soo that no one else knows and helps him keep it a secret in public. As Heung-soo accidentally becomes Jae-hee's roommate, they realize that despite not being each other's ideal types, their companionship fosters a deep and strong friendship. Together, they navigate life's unexpected challenges and rely on each other like family as they courageously pursue their own paths in love and life.

programme.title: 游龍戲鳳
programme.desc: It's hardly a coincidence that Sam is considered the most eligible bachelor in town. Not only is he a young, smart, and insightful entrepreneur with a coveted fortune, but he also happens to be a blithe spirit with a carefree attitude to life. However, every success has its price. Sam has already divorced three times and finds himself crawling back to the game of love sooner than he has expected. It is love at first sight when Sam chances upon a feisty, fast-talking woman with the odd name of Milan at a Macau casino. But the catch is, she is a part-time poker dealer and a full-time cabaret dancer, “careers” not exactly congruent with his station in life. Fallen in love against all odds, this mismatched couple soon makes headline in all media which turn Milan into an It girl overnight..

programme.title: 窄路微塵
programme.desc: Under this flashy city, amidst the numbness of frustrations, what people are looking forward to is the glimmer of light that might change their lives. Chak, who runs a small cleaning company, barely takes over the cleaning work on his own to make a living. Hitting by the COVID-19 pandemic, small business closed down one by one. One day, a young single mother, Candy, comes to look for a job opportunity from Chak. She doesn't seem like a trustworthy person to Chak, unexpectedly, she helps Chak to resolve many difficulties at work. Life seems like get back on track. The morning sun never lasts a day, Chak's company is being accused, at the same time, his family is facing a nightmare as well, all his hopes are dashed to pieces, but they can still try their best to resist the oppression of life and support each other through this painful year.

programme.title: 芳寸之地
programme.desc: For Sarya (17), a Kurdish refugee girl in Japan, life seems to be looking up; her grades at school are enough to pursue college, she's surrounded with good friends and her relationship with Sota is becoming special. Sarya's life becomes upside down, however, when she learns that her family's refugee status is turned down, restricting her family from work and traveling across the city. Her father, who had continued to work to sustain a living, is taken into custody for illegal employment. Sarya is now suddenly forced into a situation where she is responsible not only for her younger siblings but for her very existence.

programme.title: 一路驚喜
programme.desc: Set against the background of the Chinese New Year when everybody in China would head back to his hometown to celebrate with his family, this film consists of six hilarious and heartwarming stories set in ten cities across China..

credits.director: 金依萌, 潘安子, 章家瑞, 宋迪

programme.title: 真愛試煉場: 小白龍情海翻波
programme.desc: 'Little White Dragon', a noblewoman and a kung fu hero whose beauty soon caught the eyes of the crown prince. He sent White Dragon to capture an assassin, a blind swordsman..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -逃出大風鎮
programme.desc: In the film “Trapped”, border town Mangya was taken over by a group of bandits where only three police officers with one pistol stationed. How could they bring all 44 bandits to justice? First-time director Zhang Qi reveals the inspirations and ideas behind in particular the story of notorious four criminals from the Mainland and Hong Kong's “King of Robbery” Yip Kai Foon while also tells more about his creative motive for several scenes of violence on screen.

programme.title: 大風殺
programme.desc: The year is 1995. Mangya, a northwestern border town of China has become a ghost town since the once-prosperous mine and border trades shut down. The town has become an island, isolated from the outside world. There is only one police station with three police officers and one gun. XIA Ran, a retired soldier has spent over a decade here. There's a saying that he's the last survivor of the battlefield but he never talk about his story. Sandstorms hit the town once a year, and a catastrophic, once-in-decade sandstorm is forecasted for this year. The storm looms on the horizon; the final transport out of town has long left. In the dead of night, five corpses are tossed into the oil tank in the town's sole gas station. The piercing silence is interrupted by a pack of uninvited guests. However, what frightens XIA Ran more than the murders is that the gas station's tank has been emptied and the town's phone line has been severed. As the sandstorm closes in on Mangya, he realizes th.

programme.title: 毒。誡
programme.desc: This is a true story based on a repented gangster preaching the word of God and guiding his brotherhood to turn over a new leaf. Chen once was the leader of the famous gang “The 13 Tsz Wan Shan”, he lost his family, lovers, brothers and finally ended up imprisoned for his drug abuse and trafficking. After jail, he devoted himself to save the lost fellows and was selected as “The JCI Hong Kong Ten Outstanding Young Persons”. Being respected by the world, Chen is always asked to solve the most difficult situations between evil and good. People give him a nickname “The Fixer”. However, there are two sides of a coin, Chen can work out any problem of others, he does not know how to deal with his personal knot with his love, with whom he has had guilty conscience all his life. Can he fix it eventually.

programme.title: 漫長的一天
programme.desc: A story about people meeting and parting with each other as they wander through a dreamlike day. They are all wandering, in her memories, in his novel and in their movies. An omnibus film that explores hellos, goodbyes, longings and reunions throughout the events of a single day.

programme.title: 八佰
programme.desc: The film is based on true stories taking place during Sino-Japanese war in Shanghai, China, in 1937, the battle and protection of the Si Hang Warehouse. There are around 400 soldiers (so called Eight Hundred Heroes in history), holding out against numerous waves of Japanese forces for 4 days and 4 nights..

programme.title: 長安三萬里
programme.desc: A few years after the outbreak of the Anshi Rebellion, the Tubo army attacked the southwest. Gao Shi, who was trapped in the isolated city, recalled his life with Li Bai to the eunuch of the supervising army.

programme.title: 極速快遞
programme.desc: “I deliver everything that the post office service does not handle.” Eun-ha, who is a normal junkyard employee, secretly works as a delivery clerk that deals with unusual delivery request. One day, Eun-ha heads to Seoul to pick up a client who is involved in a gambling crime that wants to flee overseas. However, Eun-ha meets the client's young son at the pick-up point, instead of the client himself. Kyung-pil, a current police officer who is actually masterminding the whole gambling crime, chases after the missing child who has the security key to the bank account that holds 30 million dollars. After a long pursuit from Seoul to Busan, Eun-ha fights against the police to protect the child.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Mrs. K
programme.desc: Mrs. K is a housewife who lives in a quiet suburban neighborhood with her husband Mr. K and their daughter Lil' K. One day, a Macau ex-cop shows up to blackmail Mrs. K. He knows about her unseemly past. She agrees to his term and they meet. The deal goes sour as she attempts to get rid of him. He escapes and is captured by a stranger. After finding out why Ex-cop is mixed up in this, the stranger kills him. They are after Mrs. K for different reasons. Ex-cop is someone who stumbles upon Mrs. K's identity and decides to try his luck. The stranger, however, bears a grudge against Mrs. K. Things would date back more than ten years ago when a Macau casino was robbed. The robbery was carried out by a band of professionals and was led by none other than Mrs. K..

programme.title: 把幸福拉近一點
programme.desc: Abandoned by her mother, Xiaofei, a positive and cheerful girl, encounters a 'Wish Come True Machine' that can fulfil people's wishes, and forms a bond with a young talent named Wai who suffers from a rare disease. While Xiaofei is finding the lost lover of Wai, it is discovered that the new medicine for treating Wai's rare disease is ineffective. However, life affects life. Although Xiaofei and Wai are hit hard by fate, they decided to continue their love and hope.

programme.title: 忘不了
programme.desc: Siu Wai is widowed when her husband was killed in accident. She becomes a mini-bus driver for her living and gradually finds comfort in Dai Fai. As Dai Fai falls for Siu Wai..

programme.title: 末日廝殺橋
programme.desc: Due to sudden deteriorating weather conditions, visibility on the Airport Bridge is severely impaired, leaving people stranded and at risk of the bridge collapsing due to a series of chain collisions and explosions. Amidst the chaos, the canine subjects 'Echo' from the military experiment 'Project Silence,' who were being transported in secret, break free, and all human survivors become targets of relentless attacks. Various individuals find themselves stranded on the Airport Bridge for different reasons - a government official from the presidential office who was seeing off his daughter at the airport; a tow truck driver who was on his way to a multi-collision scene; an elderly who were returning from a trip abroad; sisters who missed their flights, and Dr. Yang, the researcher responsible for Project Silence - and a desperate struggle begins for them to escape to safety.

programme.title: 阿宅的戀愛太難
programme.desc: At her new company, Narumi Momose, a 26-year-old office clerk, is reunited with her childhood friend Hirotaka Nifuji. Hirotaka is a good-looking and competent businessman, but he is actually a severe game otaku. On the other hand, Narumi is a closet “fujoshi” (women who like anime, manga, and novels). Narumi, who more than anything fears being exposed as an otaku, hides her true nature. Hirotaka, a fellow otaku, is the only person she can be herself with. After work, they often go out drinking and have lively discussions on otaku topics. Narumi laments to Hirotaka that she is a poor judge of character and always falls for the wrong guy. Hirotaka responds, “Maybe you'd be comfortable with an otaku boyfriend.” He suggests that they start seeing each other as boyfriend and girlfriend. Narumi agrees. They look forward to being a happy otaku couple, but their romance runs into unexpected walls and challenges.

programme.title: 真愛試煉場: 愛情萬歲
programme.desc: Ching and Sung work in “Love Cafe” in the dazzling Soho and the main job is to cure broken hearts. But happiness won't last forever. After gathering with schoolmates, where Ching's ex-boyfriend Hung showed up, depute between Ching and Sung breaks out and their plan to study in Beijing almost vanishes... Joe met Kelly in a disco and falls into her in the first sight. However, Kelly is in fact a weapon of Joe's ex-girlfriend for revenge. But the more Kelly knows about Joe, the less she can pull herself out of the relationship... Yu has a handsome and career type boyfriend who will buy her everything. But what she needs is care which can't be bought. Sing, having a crush on Yu, always stands by her and comforts her desperate heart. But their 6-year age difference seems a gap that Yu couldn't step forward.

programme.title: 片場職人 -吳君如
programme.desc: In the second part of the interview, Sandra Ng revisits some of her early iconic comedies and tells how the giddy on-screen persona was established turning her to stay on the path of a comedian. She also gives a peek into her inner world as a female creator, unveiling the true side of this highly influential comedy actress.

programme.title: 絕命狂逃
programme.desc: “I've decided my own future” Near the Korean Demilitarized Zone, in a North Korean frontline military unit, Sgt. Kyu-nam is nearing the end of his ten-year service. Discontent with the lack of future prospects in the North, he plans to escape beyond the barbed wire to a place where he can freely pursue his desires. However, when a junior soldier, Dong-hyuk, discovers Kyu-nam's plan and attempts to escape first, Kyu-nam is caught in a sudden twist of fate, leading to his arrest as a defector. “Don't be distracted and accept it. This is your fate.” State Security officer Hyun-sang arrives at the base to investigate the defector. Recognizing Kyu-nam from his childhood, Hyun-sang manipulates the situation to turn Kyu-nam into a hero who captured the defector, thereby boosting his own credentials and securing a position as a special assistant to the division commander.But when Kyu-nam makes a determined effort to escape, Hyun-sang is left with no choice but to begin an unyielding.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 從今以後
programme.desc: Angie and Pat are a lesbian couple who have been together for over four decades. Pat bought an apartment over thirty years ago where they have lived ever since. The couple is open to their families and often invites Pat's family to their home for dinners. Angie's relationship with them has always been very close. When Pat passes away unexpectedly, Angie is suddenly left on her own to deal with matters related to Pat and her estate. It is not too long before a clash develops over their opinions about the burial arrangements. Angie begins to feel increasingly alienated from Pat's family..

programme.title: 刺心切骨
programme.desc: Young fencer Zijie finds his world upended when his older brother, three-time national fencing champion Zihan, is released from juvenile prison. Zihan was incarcerated for what he maintains was the accidental death of an opponent. Zijie wants some connection (and fencing tips) from his enigmatic older brother, but their mother is convinced of Zihan's malevolence and seeks to end their brotherly bond. Featuring meticulously staged fencing matches and pitch-perfect performances, this unnerving psychodrama announces Nelicia Low as a future talent to follow.

programme.title: 獵戰
programme.desc: After a high-ranking North Korean official requests asylum, KCIA Foreign Unit chief Park Pyong-ho (LEE Jung Jae) and Domestic Unit chief Kim Jung-do (JUNG Woo Sung) are tasked with uncovering a North Korean spy, known as Donglim, who is deeply embedded within their agency. When the spy begins leaking top secret intel that could jeopardize national security, the two units are each assigned to investigate each other. In this tense situation where if they cannot find the mole, they may be accused themselves, Pyong-ho and Jung-do slowly start to uncover the truth. In the end, they must deal with an unthinkable plot to assassinate the South Korean president..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 怒潮
programme.desc: Amid the transfer of power at the Hongtai Group, which wields influence in both the lawful and unlawful worlds, a mysterious assassin named Chen An suddenly enters this vortex of confusion and throws the Hongtai Group into chaos. Mai Longwen from the police and Ma Wenkang from the gangs both have their eyes on him... Various forces are waiting for the opportunity to strike. Who is the mastermind behind the scenes? A fierce battle is about to break out.

programme.title: 赤狐書生
programme.desc: To achieve immortality, fox spirit Bai Shisan disguises as a young man and travels to the human world in search of a divine pill. There he befriends the innocent scholar Wang Zijin shom he later realizes is the key to his transcendence. To keep Wang safe, Bai must bond with him on his road to the imperial examination and fends off threats from mythic creatures and evil spirits.

programme.title: 六樓后座
programme.desc: Six twentysomethings from their own worlds converge at a bargain apartment affordable by one but perfect for six. With a goal to reach, a deal they make, and a year to complete, they 'fulfill' them with indulging pleasures and, endless games of truth or dare, and madness nourishing the 6th Floor Rear Flat. Sweet Dreams die well when the 12-month lease ends come an unwelcome reminder, the lost souls wake with frightening awareness to the touchline once they think never impossible. Between being responsible and getting away, is youth still a mighty weapon for failures.

programme.title: 好好拍電影
programme.desc: On a buzzing red carpet, a 70-year-old short-haired woman strides towards the stage with confidence. Behind the red carpet, it's a muddy path that leads to a movie studio in New Territories, Hong Kong. To her, glory and hardship are nothing more than just different paths that lead to the world of cinema. Born in Northeastern China, raised in Macau and educated in Hong Kong, Ann Hui stays true to her cultural heritage as a Chinese, yet she has always been fascinated by Western literature and therefore decided to further her studies in London. Eventually, she found movies. Through movies, she becomes fully immersed into the ‘East-meets-West' culture and lifestyle of Hong Kong; She reconciles with her distant mother; And she gets to explore the cultural and social identity of her and the city she calls home. Movies also found her. Having learned from veteran auteur King Hu, her directorial debut became part of the impetus behind Hong Kong's New Wave as she explores marginalize.

programme.title: 我在時間盡頭等你
programme.desc: Some lives are linked across time, connected by destiny. While aiding an old theatre attendant Lin Ge (Lee Hongchi), aspiring dancer Qiu Qian (Li Yitong) stumbles upon his diary which chronicles the life and memories they shared together since childhood, thus discovering a timeless love story concealed in another dimension.

programme.title: 信用欺詐師JP：英雄篇
programme.desc: The “Third Generation Tsuchinoko” -- the master con man hailed as a “hero” has died. Dako, Boku-chan and Richard all honed their skills under his tutelage. The title of 'Tsuchinoko' is handed down in secrecy to the Confidence Man (scammer) with the greatest skill, setting the stage for a showdown between his three star pupils. The contest will take place in the world heritage city of Valletta, Malta, an international gathering place for the rich and famous.Their target is the invaluable ancient Greek sculpture “Dancing Venus”, currently owned by a wealthy, retired Spanish gangster. Each scammer adopts a unique strategy in pursuit of the target, but the police and Interpol are also hot on their heels. Who will laugh last?! No one knows how the biggest scam in history will end! Who is the true 'hero' and what is the ultimate 'truth'? The last con game, grand finale, Battle Royale...begins now.

programme.title: 救參的士
programme.desc: In 1987, diplomat 'Min-jun' was unable to escape the Middle East Department at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for five years. One day, he receives a coded message from a missing diplomat in Lebanon, who was kidnapped 20 months ago. Filled with hopeful aspirations of a promotion to the United States if successful, he volunteers for an unofficial mission to rescue his colleague and heads to Lebanon. Upon arrival at the airport, 'Min-jun' narrowly avoids a hail of bullets from airport security guards who are after his life. By chance, he ends up getting into the car of a Korean taxi driver named 'Pan-su'. With local gangsters hot on their heels attempting to steal the ransom money, 'Min-jun' has no choice but to rely on expat Pan-su, the only fellow Korean around. However, can this shady character, who will do anything for money, truly help in rescuing his colleague.

programme.title: 真愛試煉場: 當男人戀愛時
programme.desc: A-cheng is a rogue who relies on debt collection for living. He lives in the attic of a small barber shop managed by his elder brother. It's time for a 37-year-old adult to live on his own, but he always ignores all contempt from others. One day, he goes to the hospital to collect a debt from a creditor in coma, there he meets Hao-ting, daughter of the creditor. She is forced to sign a debt transferring contract without any complaint. Her silhouette of silently taking care of her father deeply attracts A-cheng, a guy who never had responsibility before. A-cheng clumsily draws a “graffiti contract” to offset Hao-ting's debts with walks and dinners as dating, even tries his best to manage the funeral for her father. Hao-ting feels touched by his behaviors and accepts his pursuit. Unexpectedly, a barter gambling takes away their future ruthlessly. A-cheng is not only imprisoned, also diagnosed with hemangioma. He has not much time left...At that moment, A-cheng finally understan.

programme.title: 販賣．愛
programme.desc: Due to financial needs, undergraduate Tiffany took up compensated dating, regarding it as a personal choice that has nothing to do with ethics. Though at first, she's feeling a bit uneasy, but soon she became indifferent. After one unpleasant experience serving a group of Japanese clients, she wanted to quit. But her agent Hazelnut convinced her to take up a long-term sponsor Cheung. In the course of serving Cheung, a subtle feeling nourished between the two. On the other hand, she came across Rex, a young guy of integrity and passion. After one incident, she decided to quit Cheung and took up a new life with Rex. But just when she thought she could start over anew, something unexpected turned up making her realized that she had to pay for what she had chosen before..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -無以名狀的愛
programme.desc: Superstar Aaron Kwok and rising star Natalie Hsu team up for the film “My First Of May” which unfolds the little-known side of family dealing with rare diseases. Aaron, as a real-life father, finds it challenging to play the irresponsible father, and praises Natalie's performance as his daughter who suffers from muscular dystrophy. Director James Hung also shares his creative initiatives for this film, hoping that audiences will feel the bittersweet journey of patients and caregivers.

programme.title: Laughing Gor之潛罪犯
programme.desc: To undertake the ending of TV drama “Lives of Omission”, Laughing is sentenced to life-imprisonment for killing Michael. In the prison, Laughing got to know Professor Fok, an introvert serving his sentence for drug-dealing. Professor Fok is a gifted psychologist who reads mind: discovering the deepest, darkest secrets of others, thus enabling him to manipulate and control others. Laughing learns more of psychology and he holds a strong admiration for Professor Fok. But in fact, Professor Fok has an ulterior motive. Laughing, confirming his imprisonment is all part of a new secret mission, the Security Bureau wants Laughing to infiltrate in prison to investigate further for the suspected corrupted cops..

programme.title: 滿江紅
programme.desc: 12th century China, during the Song Dynasty, set against a brewing rebellion by the Jin people against the Imperial Court.Two hours before a crucial diplomatic meeting between the Song Prime Minister Qin Hui and a high level Jin delegation, the Jin Ambassador is murdered. An important letter destined for the Emperor is stolen from him. As the search for the letter unfolds, alliances are formed, secrets are revealed, and no one can stop the truth that is destined to leave its mark in history.

programme.title: 一念無明
programme.desc: The film begins with an old man who has long been absent as a father, picking up his son, who is suffering from bipolar disorder, from a mental hospital. Both men are in deep remorse for the accident that caused the death of the mother. The tension and anxiety boil as they stay with each other in a tiny subdivided flat. As time passes, they realize the pain between one another is not the only confrontation that awaits them; but to face the cruel world that they are living in.

programme.title: 詛咒
programme.desc: When the leading dancer of Lola – the most anticipated new musical in China – is gruesomely murdered in her dressing room on the very night of the premiere, terror looms over the dance troupe. With the murderer still at large, the coveted role of Lola quickly passes to, a talented but introverted dancer with a traumatic childhood. Suspicion fanned by jealousy soon leads to hostility and rejection from fellow dancers, while figments of childhood memories start haunting her every dream. Tian can only seek solace in the arms of her gaffer boyfriend. As the cold-blooded murderer strikes again, Tian begins to realize that all the slayings are somehow related to her. No sooner is she inextricably sucked into the curse of the role than she starts suspecting Zhen may actually be harboring a horrifying secret behind these murders and the troupe itself. But will she live long enough to uncover the secret and dispel the curse.

programme.title: 三不管
programme.desc: In one of the darkest and diverse cultural part in the city, there is a minority group who lives in the place where it is full of despair and frustration. At first glance, their desperate living comprises illegal gambling, prostitution as well as drug-dealing. Indeed, their way of living is guided by their own norms and laws, regardless of the entrenched ones prevailing in the general public. Although their norms are chaotic and arbitrary, they do not violate the existence of the conventional ones. Consequently, it can be said that this chaotic region is unique within the city. On one occasion, there are two men, riding in a vehicle, unexpectedly enter this restricted region..

programme.title: 假冒女團
programme.desc: Cercis Lui goes undercover in this lively comedy as an officer of the 'International Association for the Physical and Mental Health Development of Underage Boys and Girls” dedicated to protecting young boys and girls from being exploited in their pursuit of pop stardom. When tasked with taking down a shady talent show and its mastermind, Big Boss, Cercis must disguise himself as a woman to enter the competition. Only then can he get close enough to gather the evidence to take down the criminal ring. Joining this outlandish operation are Helianthus - an entertainment reporter, Circle O – a wannabe popstar, Lilium - a notorious artist and Oval O – cousin of Circle O from the US. But does this ragtag team have what it takes to triumph over the shady side of the business.

programme.title: 此情此刻
programme.desc: 'The Moment' talks about four relationships - A couple breaking up yet holding tight; a father and a daughter meeting up after a long separation; a girl escaping from growing up; and two buddies' reunion after years of misunderstanding. Different people carry different stories. The stories are connected by a vintage photography studio holder. Their experiences bring out a variety of sensations to the city we are living in; these feelings belong to them, and also us.

programme.title: 隔牆有愛
programme.desc: Flirting with a wall between them! Seung-jin wants to become a singer, so he's preparing for a TV audition program. It's his first night at his new place. He suddenly hears a woman's ghostly wails! It turns out that Seung-jin's next door neighbor, Ra-ni has been driving people away from this apartment because of the super-thin walls! But Seung-jin won't go without a fight! After a battle of loud noises, they decide to take turns being noisy. They don't know each other's names or faces. But as they share their lives, they start to develop strange feelings for each other... The thin walls force them to share everything with each other. It's a brand new kind of romance.

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：黃子華: 失戀急讓
programme.desc: Lung is facing a serious situation in life. His girlfriend won't marry him unless he can buy her a 1000-sq ft apartment in one year's time..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 快一秒的他
programme.desc: Hajime is a handsome young man, who is always a second quicker than everyone else. He works at the post office, where Reika comes to buy a stamp every day. Reika is a young woman, who is always a second slower than everyone else. On the day after Valentine's Day, Hajime wakes up to find himself losing all his memories from the previous day... A remake of the Best Film Winner at the Taipei Golden Horse Awards, My Missing Valentine, and relocating the story to Kyoto, the film tells a quirky romance caught in unexpected time differences.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 原諒他77次
programme.desc: When Adam and Eva break up after ten years, Adam thinks the breach was caused by one trivial incident, but Eva knows she's already forgiven Adam 77 times! Sweethearts since law school, Adam changed professions to start a Thai boxing studio and gradually became indifferent to Eva. Seemingly petty matters, like forgetting she hates raisin cookies, become the catalyst for her moving out and changing her Facebook status to 'single'. Despondent, Adam has a drunken tryst with his student, Mandy. Adam gains new insight after accidentally discovering Eva's private journal. Entitled '77 Heartbreaks', the title refers to the philosophy that 'forgiving someone 7 times isn't enough; 70 x 7 times is too much; so go ahead and forgive 77 times!' Reading it makes Adam realize his love. But what can he do to win her back? And what secret is contained in the journal's torn-out last page? He rushes to Eva and melts her heart by recounting their happy memories. When Eva tells him Heartbreak #77.

programme.title: 真愛試煉場: 30日求「分」大作戰
programme.desc: “I was perfect until God threw this woman into my life” JUNG-YEOL, the intelligent and handsome loser. “He's like a mosquito. Who knows why they exist?” NARA, the successful careerwoman born with a side of crazy. Despite being brought together by a cinematic encounter that led to their storybook romance, the two have now grown sick of each other's nutty and loserish ways, finally deciding to become perfect strangers again. But......with D-30 until they stamp their papers, a fateful accident inflicts amnesia on the star-crossed couple.

programme.title: 百味映人生: 花椒之味
programme.desc: After her father died, a Hong Kong girl discovers she has two hitherto unknown sisters, one in Taiwan and one in China. To settle her father's debt, she must reunite with them to run the family's hot pot restaurant. While the androgynous Taiwan sister is plagued by her toxic relationship with her mother, the fashionista sister from China is trying to fend off her grandmother's pressure to get married. Meanwhile, she is striving to unshackle herself from her ex-boyfriend in order to start a new relationship.

programme.title: 單身男女
programme.desc: Yen is a single girl from China working in an IT company in Hong Kong. Overwhelmed by the hustle and bustle of this sleepless city, she feels increasingly like a fish out of water. Until she meets a handsome hunk, Sean and an elite architect, Kevin. Yen is no longer alone and lonely, but will she be able to find her true love.

programme.title: 單身男女2

programme.desc: Yi-jung lives with her mother Su-kyung, but they do not get along well with each other. Yi-jung does not believe Su-kyung's claim that the car suddenly accelerated on its own and thinks her mother hit her on purpose. Now, Yi-jung wants an apology from Su-kyung for everything that happened in her life.

programme.title: 我知女人心
programme.desc: Sun is not exactly the ideal husband, father or son, but family takes the backseat against career. As the top brass of the leading ad agency, his mind is only fixed on being promoted to the executive creative director post. But the announcement comes and Sun is beaten by a new colleague Ly, renowned as the Iron Lady in the ad industry. The boss believes Ly would bring a competitive edge for the agency - the female perspective. Sun and Ly are at loggerheads at first sight, and she gives him an assignment - takes home a box of female hygiene products, and present an ad idea the next morning. That night, Sun is brainstorming in the bathtub when he accidentally drops a lamp in the water. The electric shock knocks him out, and when he wakes up in the hospital, he realizes he has a new gift - he can really hear what women think! By listening to the inner thoughts of the opposite sex, Sun quickly wins the hearts and trust of all women..

programme.title: 超能神探

Will he be able to succeed both, as a father who struggles with the relationship with his daughter, and as a cop with a superpower who is eager to catch an evil criminal.

programme.title: 蕩寇風雲
programme.desc: During the 16th century, Japanese pirates proliferate along the Chinese coastline. In 1557, the pirates take over Cengang in Zhejiang. After months of futile advances, Commander Yu finally defeats them under the leadership of newly promoted General Qi. The pirates, however, manage to escape. No sooner has Qi identified the key weakness of the Chinese army than he starts remapping the coastal regions to eradicate the pirates. When he finds the villagers of Yiwu loyal and courageous, he drafts them into his own army which soon becomes a formidable force against the pirates, with tactics developed specifically against them. In 1561, the pirates regroup and once again attack the coastal cities of China. With both the cities of Xinhe and Taizhou under attack, Qi's army is caught between two fires. Even though most family members of his soldiers are located in Xinhe, Qi makes the tough decision to go to Taizhou and leaves his wife in charge of the fight against the pirates in Xinhe.

Then she picked up a lighter and lit it. Her whole body was on fire, and she screamed in pain. All the environmental evidence points to the teacher assisting others to commit suicide. The only thing is that he refused to admit murder, saying that he lost his memory..

programme.title: 大佬愛美麗
programme.desc: Georgie's dad, Hung, was a Triad leader. After Hung's death, his right-hand Cheung intends to bring back Georgie to take over. But Cheung finds Sam, whom he mistakes for Georgie..

programme.title: 香港四徑大步走
programme.desc: At the time, they said it couldn't be done. In 2012, Andre Blumberg set off by himself, to run all four of Hong Kong's iconic ultra distance trails in just four days. 298km and over 14,500m of climbing later, one of the hardest ultra marathons in the world - the Hong Kong Four Trails Ultra Challenge - was born. With the 2021 edition of the challenge as the backdrop, 'Four Trails' takes you on a journey from when the concept was first was conceived to it's current format. Under 60 hours to be deemed a 'Finisher' and under 72 hours to be a ‘Survivor', unsupported and with an ever evolving set of rules. It takes a deep dive into the famous four trails that make up the challenge and you will both laugh and cry as the astonishing stories of those who dare attempt such a feat unfold.

While suffering from his debacle, Dae-su becomes shocked when he watches the news and hears that his beloved wife was brutally murdered. 15 years later, Dae-su is released and he determines to find out the truth. He meets Mi-do, the cook of the restaurant Dae-su has his first-meal after his imprisonment, and tells her about his 15 years in confinement. Mi-do promises to help him seek vengeance. programme.desc: Believing that writing Cantopop is her God-given talent, Law Wing-sze decides to make it her lifelong career. The first major motion picture about Cantopop lyrics writing. Norris Wong's long-awaited follow-up to her acclaimed debut My Prince Edward is an unsentimental autobiographical dramedy that reminds us no dream is guaranteed to come true. Ironically, the film's star, up-and-coming actress Chung Suet-ying, is actually a real-life Cantopop lyricist.

The long-awaited gathering prompted everyone to rethink their relationships with family members. Some choose to leave, some are back. programme.desc: With glorious days from five consecutive championships in the 1980s, the Women's National Volleyball Team of China had transcended the conventional definition of sports in the hearts of Chinese people. When the Chinese team was pitted against the US team led by Lang Ping at the 2008 Beijing Volleyball Game, everyone knew that it was a match that China could not lose, and certainly could not afford to lose. Defeated, the Chinese team plunged into the deepest abyss in three decades. As Lang Ping returned to her country to coach the team, many mused aloud as to whether China's Women's National Volleyball Team would be able to retrieve lost grounds. The film recounts the ups and downs, the sweat and sacrifice of the team over the past four decades. While the team's persistence and teamwork became a national inspiration and collective memory in the 80s, whether the team spirit can be passed down to the new generation as China goes through rapid changes.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -陳可辛的奪冠夢

When she writes, though, she is not constrained by reality. Pouring herself into essays, Myung-eun takes pride in constructing a different world of her own. However, the candid writings of a new student shake her sense of self, and prompt Myung-eun to better understand her family. Reminiscent of acclaimed coming-of-age Korean indies like The World of Us and House of Hummingbird, writer-director Lee Ji-eun's understated debut feature excels in its perceptive depiction of the emotions and experiences of a child trying to find her place in the world.

Left alone in China, Shui Zhang grows up to be a braggart and a nobody. When Shui Zhang travels to France one day to enlist Waley's help in auctioning a bottle of red wine called 'The God of Wine,' said to contain Kublai Khan's secret wine-brewing recipe, Waley accepted the challenge in a heartbeat. During the auction, Waley encounters a representative from the seller, the beautiful Yvonne, and falls in love with her at first sight. The other potential buyer is the wealthy and imposing coal tycoon Changfang Fang. While he appears to be a rich and vulgar brute on the surface, he is much more than meets the eyes. Adding to the mystery is the private connoisseur of suspicious origins following Fang everywhere. To Waley's surprise, Zhang and Fang seem to be sharing secrets between themselves. The group of buyers set off an.

The Center for Disease Control orders the hotel to be sealed, forcing its guests to undergo a mandatory 14-day quarantine. However, being isolated from the world ends up bringing the quarantined people together in unexpected ways. As they bond over this difficult time, they learn to treasure what may be their final moments together.

As everything was destroyed during the great battle, Nuwa (Goddess of Works) used 36,500 magic boulders to repair Heaven. One of them fell accidentally down onto Earth and landed on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruits on an island far across the Eastern Sea. Over thousands of years, the magic boulder absorbed the energies of Heaven and Earth and the sacred lights of the Sun and Moon. A godly creature was nurtured inside the stone-egg and a full-grown monkey burst out from it one day. When the Patriarch Subodhi passed by on his way to collect herbs in the Mountain, he came upon the monkey. Impressed by his exceptional wit and godly he took the monkey back to the Divine Cave of Three Stars in Mountain Mi to teach him the Way and called him Sun Wukong..

Upon learning that Surewin was Lui's former student, Elsa seeks him out to train her at his gym. Upon learning that Surewin was Lui's former student, Elsa seeks him out to train her at his gym. He promises to pay each of the 30 neighbours HK$100 million as compensation as long as a representative of each household returns to the estate on Lunar New Year's Eve. He then seals both of them in the seven-colored sacred lotus. The spiritual pill will reincarnate as a man, who is destined to assist in the creation of the new Zhou dynasty; whilst a demon will be born of the sorcery pill, who is set to bring great destructions to the world. To prevent disasters, Yuanshi Tianzun has initiated a kalpa spell to strike the sorcery pill with thunder in three years. Facing the advent of the thunder, will Nezha still be the demon as destined? What will he choose.

Totonou decides to help her out, only to get involved in an inheritance battle of the noble and shady Kariatsumari family, where people have been killed for generations. In 1970s Hong Kong, rapacious landlords try to evict 72 tenants but sworn brothers Ha Kugn and Shek Kin help the group of 72 defeat the landlord and landlady and coincidentally rescue Pinky from a planned forced marriage. When both sworn brothers fall for Pinky and propose to her, she flips a coin 'heads or tails' and Ha wins her hand in marriage. Not only was Yu immersed in the online romance, but Joe also found pleasure and satisfaction in creating romantic experiences for Yu. programme.title: 寒戰
programme.desc: Approaching midnight in Hong Kong, police headquarters receives an anonymous call: a police van carrying the advanced equipment and five officers has disappeared off the grid..

programme.title: 寒戰2
programme.desc: The story of this highly-anticipated sequel continues as Acting Police Commissioner Sean Lau (Aaron Kwok) is promoted to the highest rank in the police force. Joe (Eddie Peng Yuyan), son of Deputy Police Commissioner Waise Lee (Tony Leung Ka Fai) who is behind the conspiracy, is taken into custody and Waise is forced to retire. But Master, Themind remains unknown, until the resurface of a former police chief who unveils an unprecedented scheme to corrupt the police force. Things get more complicated when senior counsel Oswald Kan (Chow Yun Fat) leads an impeachment proceeding against Sean. Oswald's every decision is pivotal in determining who stays on top of the game.

programme.title: 人嚇鬼
programme.desc: In a touring opera group, the domineering star is hated by all. The lesser actors try to give him a bad time by posing as ghosts. Their antics attract the attention of a real ghost who comes to make fun of them. Stage old hand Seng soon discovers the mischievous ghost met a violent death. Seng promises to find his remains and bury him. Unwittingly, Seng buries the wrong bones which belong to the Vicious Ghost. The Vicious Ghost comes and leaves a trail of violence..

programme.title: 猛鬼佛跳牆
programme.desc: It is a dream come true for engineer Bill Cheung when a quiet villa in the countryside is assigned to him as staff quarters. As soon as he moves into this extravagant estate with his wife and 2 daughters, strange things begin to happen. When his daughter Jane discovers the previous owners were burned to death many years ago, Bill's family is already on their way to a similar tragic demise..

programme.title: 殭屍醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Chiang, a Hong Kong surgeon, finds himself surrounded by beautiful girls in an old castle. Little does he realize these are the Count's vampire girls. He has a one-night stand with Alice who bites him while he was unaware. He gradually assumes the characteristics of a vampire. Alice breaks with the Count and goes to Hong Kong to save Dr. Chiang. That gets him into hot water with his girlfriend May..

programme.title: 烈火戰車2極速傳說
programme.desc: After winning yet another race, the underground drag car racer king, Sky, was framed by his rival's brother Hung. On the run in Thailand, Sky hooks up with his long lost father, himself a legendary racer, who steers his son back on course for the ultimate showdown of speed with Hung.

programme.title: 影人映語 -關錦鵬

programme.desc: Rouge stars Leslie Cheung as Chen, the never-do-well son of a wealthy and powerful family, who defiantly falls head over heels in love with prostitute Fleur in the 1930's. Disowned and despised, the hopeless couple makes a suicide pact – but Chen finds himself unable to carry through with it..

programme.title: 薰衣草
programme.desc: Athena is an aromatherapy tutor but can't heal up her wound at heart. One day, she finds a broken-wing angel falling on balcony. A scented romance is gradually in between them..

programme.title: 太子傳說

The missing son turns up, and he's now a killer who goes by the name of Prince.

The mole is the result of a 'love spell' put by enchantress Yin Chun, who is actually an incarnation of a 3000-years old fox with great magical power..

programme.desc: Wing and Fat have the same burning ambition to be big in the underworld. They struggle and are doing very well, so well the kingpin of the gangs wants to get rid of them. Wing and Fat are forced to fight back, then the showdown comes..

Unable to salvage a fortune from Susan, Wai, Sung and Mei become indebted to her. In desperation, Wai seeks help from his mentor and he has won back all the debts they owed Susan..

The mission was to destroy the munitions left over in Vietnam during the Vietnam War. As the irregular troop, they just had informal training before they went to Vietnam. During the mission, they had to pass over mountains and challenge their own wills. They started with no trust to become mutually supportive with one another at the end. However, only few of them were able to come back eventually.

When Alex and Chu are getting closer and closer, they imperceptibly fall in love with each other. At this moment, Peggy suddenly comes back to Alex asking for being together once again. programme.desc: ME is embarked on her adventure to Europe to seek a wealthy husband, and she runs into ravishing DAN. Can she find true happiness and her glass high-heeled shoes as Cinderella did.

His brother Chi-Ying is a self-made investor who has just come up with a laugh bomb. By chance, Chi-Man becomes the host of a Cat TV program. He learns that Inspector Hua and underworld boss Wang are working together in prostitution and human traffic. Yushu helps Ru to escape from Wang 's catches. Fei, Yushu and Ru are being haunted by Hua's men, but are saved by self-styled kungfu master Jean-Paul. They are taken in by Master Yi and asks Yushu to prepare the beef noodles but he only wants to learn kungfu from Jean-Paul. However, Yushu realizes Master Yi actually is the kungfu master. He begs Master Yi to teach him the skills and fight against evil forces together..

programme.desc: Tung Choi is the third-generation shop owner of a string of beef noodle restaurants. He gets into a minor fender bender with the hard working, yet outwardly mean Deborah. The two engage in an ill-tempered spat which makes both characters seem completely unlikable. Meeting later to negotiate a truce, the two end up engaging in a one-night stand, but a happy ending is far from possible. Tung is linked to high-maintenance TV personality Mindy, and Deborah is about to encounter a fitting fall from grace. Thanks to her mean-spirited behavior, she loses her job, her home (she and her father have a spat), and possibly her self-respect. Deborah and Tung encounter each other at the hospital, where Tung is visiting his mother and Deborah is staying (as in sleeping on the floor) with her sister. Tung offers to let her freshen up at his home, but she ends up sleeping on the couch for a short period of time. Tung's extremely weird family seems against Deborah; they tout Mindy's positive p.

programme.desc: On the eve of the inauguration of Hong Kong's new airport, a Korean cargo ship is found floating in the seas off Hong Kong, its crew murdered. When it's discovered that Todd is a member of a Cambodian terrorist unit, an expert criminal psychiatrist convinces him that he is in fact an undercover agent sent to infiltrate the Cambodian organization..

programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.

Chu is promoted to be the Assistant of General Manager in a short period of time. Nevertheless, it is a fraud for Chu. Can Alex save his company from closing down and how does Alex help Chu run away from the fraud..

programme.desc: Tsu, a police officer, has a happy life with his wife, who's pregnant. But one day when he gets a tip that a bank is about to be robbed, he rushes to it but killed. The hostage Gucci then holds the loot. Tsu becomes a vampire when a cat jumps on his body and is hit by lightning. Not until he went to the hospital did he realize he was dead and needs electric recharge to be alive. In order to keep his wife from being sad, he doesn't tell her the truth. Even when his best friend Mr. Big and Gucci find it out, he asks them to keep in secret. To get back the loot, the robbers seize both Gucci and Tsu's wife, forcing Tsu to bring the loot to exchange them..

But strangely enough, she gradually becomes more and more ease with the way of life in the hospital until one day, she's forgotten what life is like outside, including her fiance. Meanwhile, Ao is out looking for her ex-husband Ma Shih-mei who heartlessly deserted her. She meets the postman who has a secret infatuation with Chang. She also makes an acquaintance with millionaire Sugar Old Man. The three of them develop the most harmonious friendship over..

They decide to “fight deceit with deceit”, exploiting Leung's greed to lure him into a trap, but Leung outsmarts Kang family. As the conflict escalates, Leung continuously sows discord between Kang's brothers Mon and Chuen. When Leung believes he has triumphed by triggering infighting within Kang family..

After the break up, she begged for ownership of the bed she's gotten used to. Carrie was assigned to follow the story of city's celebrated super cop, Paul Ko. While exchanging fire he was shot at by an AK-47 and become a sexual impotent. During the process of interviewing, Carrie has fallen to Paul. Raymond is being considered for a promotion to district court, his superiors request for him to stay away from the night-life and women. In the thick of this difficult celibate period, an 18 year old girl called Tabby barges into Raymond's life..

Later on, she becomes the head hostess of a cabaret and is famous for the way she trains inexperienced girls. Buwhay, Har Jay's daughter, grows up and revolts. She goes for an upstart mobster, Chao, and runs away from Har Jay..

She has an unpredictable character. Paul's courtship skills do not work on her. Paul is helpless. Indeed, Yung likes Paul but she is afraid that one day she may really fall in love with Paul so she goes back to Canada. Though unwilling, Paul has to put an end to this relationship.

Back in Hong Kong, a Secret Service man from the Bond Street Headquarters. Mr Tom Collins, has just arrived to find out a gang of notorious international crooks led carried out his mission successfully for Mr Bond, he is summoned by the Governor to assist Collons in retrieving the stolen goods and catch Mr BOnd's gang.

programme.title: 影人映語 -型「德」起！ - 王敏德
programme.desc: Michael Wong rose to prominence on the big screen in the 80s with his “half Chinese, half foreign' identity and eye-catching appearance, from the early rebellious and unruly big boy to the tough and strong policeman role later. Looking back the bygone days, he barely knew Cantonese but was fortunate to meet a like-minded partner who helped him through the break-in period, and which film from his decades-long career impressed him the most? After played countless roles, how does he feel about his identity as an actor.

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之二男兒當自強
programme.desc: During his stay in Canton, Wong Fey Hong meets Sun Yat Sun and Luke. He decides to help them escape by the 'cover' from the rioting White Lotus Sect.

programme.title: 月黑風高
programme.desc: Michael Chow is the chief cop of Tai O, a small rural town on Hong Kong's outlying Lantau Island. When a local man turns up dead, urban hero cop Michael Wong is sent in to help out the locals... and what follows is a cultural clash that's both humorous and utterly entertaining! Wong is an SDU cop and takes to bullying the locals with tough and hard-handed ways, but his efforts only result in resentment and anger. It's Chow who gets what the odd residents of Tai O are about, and his lackadaisical attitude is just what's needed to handle the prickly locals. But it may take the skills of both men to solve this murder case! Though nominally a cop film, this unique creation is as much a comedy of cultural errors as a murder mystery.

programme.title: 東方三俠

programme.title: 現代豪俠傳
