programme.title: 至尊計狀元才
programme.desc: As a prominent gambler, Ray has encountered many challenges in his career. When Chiang challenges Ray to a gambling contest with him in Macau, Ray's adventures begins again..

programme.title: 攝氏32度
programme.desc: A nameless hitwoman who, for reasons not entirely clear, has a lower than average body temperature. She is cold-blooded in other ways as well, assassinating her targets with steely detachment and having only two real acquaintances: the Cambodian woman who gives her killing assignments and money, and the street vendor Long Shek, at whose stand she habitually relaxes after successful hits with a bowl of noodles. Long Shek dubs her Pretty Ghost, and the two gradually become something like friends. Pretty Ghost ends up traveling to South Korea to assassinate a local gangland kingpin, a job she decides will be her last. However, the dead man's bodyguard, Yichin, is out for revenge and comes after Pretty Ghost..

Misery has lost her mind and she threatens to destroy Omei unless May beats her with the sect's long-lost 'Heartbreak Sword Technique'..

programme.title: 午夜麗人
programme.desc: Blackie and Ling are working in a reputable business firm. Blackie who was a night club hostess and is now living with her boyfriend. Ling does not like office work. They are keen to make big money so they try to get racing tips from a young jockey..

During an emotional reunion, Mark asks Ho to take revenge on Shing and reclaim their positions in the organization, but Ho refuses. Shing finds Ho and presses him to come back to his organization, offering to reinstate Mark if he returns. Ho flatly refuses. Consequently, Shing begins harassing Ho in order to get him to return, including luring Kit into a trap and injuring Kit, attacking Ho's co-workers, and hav.

How does he feel when looking back at his experience throughout these years? Also, perceiving that Hong Kong is his ‘root', what kind of wisdom he would like to share with the audience.

programme.title: 逃學威龍

At the Same Time, he destorys a munition smuggling activity. This leads the smugglers to school to take revenge. A group of students is being kept hostage. programme.desc: “The Banquet” assembled star-studded cast that aimed for charity to support disaster relief efforts at that time. Adapted from the 1959 Cantonese film of the same name and co-directed by Tsui Hark, Clifton Ko, Joe Cheung, and Alfred Cheung, the film tells the story of a greedy couple deceiving their estranged father to secure a huge amount business deal with oil producing country. While they pretend to welcome the father into their home and prepare a birthday banquet for him, rival also throws a competing banquet...With continuous top-star cameos offering countless surprises and laughs, this film remains remarkable, entertaining and meaningful to audience nowadays.

It is during this fateful weekend that he meets Choi; a struggling stockbroker who is trying ward off the attentions of an unwanted suitor from her local village. programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: On a wild and dangerous adventure to Mexico, BMX bikers Rooftop and Catfish test how gutsy they really are. The pair go from racing bikes to racing donkeys, flame throwing and tricking in pointy shoes on the streets, to loosing their breakfast trying to eat eyeball tacos for lunch. But the duo’s bravery (or stupidity) doesn’t end there. They compete in a rodeo, milk a snake for its venom, spin upside down as Voladores in a traditional rain ceremony, and get tattoos right before diving into the city’s toxic sewage. With all of these dauntless activities the question becomes, can Rooftop and Catfish make it out of Mexico in one piece.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite.

programme.title: Making Pandas 第1季
programme.desc: The iconic Giant Panda is on the brink. With only 1600 left in the wild, pressures on their natural habitat and a notoriously small window for reproduction are edging them towards extinction - fast.\nOver 1 year, we go behind-the-scenes and follow the incredible work of a dedicated group of zookeepers and vets as they race to get Singapore’s famed couple… to fall in ‘love’. \nThe team from the River Safari has a tough road ahead. This film follows the year that Kai Kai and Jia Jia become the focus of attention not just from the general public but from the scientists themselves in the greatest challenge Singapore Zoo has faced yet.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: On a wild and dangerous adventure to Mexico, BMX bikers Rooftop and Catfish test how gutsy they really are. The pair go from racing bikes to racing donkeys, flame throwing and tricking in pointy shoes on the streets, to loosing their breakfast trying to eat eyeball tacos for lunch. But the duo’s bravery (or stupidity) doesn’t end there. They compete in a rodeo, milk a snake for its venom, spin upside down as Voladores in a traditional rain ceremony, and get tattoos right before diving into the city’s toxic sewage. With all of these dauntless activities the question becomes, can Rooftop and Catfish make it out of Mexico in one piece.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite.

programme.title: Gold Fever 第4季
programme.desc: It’s a big year for the Cripple River mining camp in Nome Alaska. The crew is extremely busy and the participants are already finding some of the biggest gold in recent history.

programme.desc: Tom’s been dredging a spot on Arctic creek for the past couple years. Now is the time he and Kia are gonna open the hole up in hopes of finding some serious gold.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: On a wild and dangerous adventure to Mexico, BMX bikers Rooftop and Catfish test how gutsy they really are. The pair go from racing bikes to racing donkeys, flame throwing and tricking in pointy shoes on the streets, to loosing their breakfast trying to eat eyeball tacos for lunch. But the duo’s bravery (or stupidity) doesn’t end there. They compete in a rodeo, milk a snake for its venom, spin upside down as Voladores in a traditional rain ceremony, and get tattoos right before diving into the city’s toxic sewage. With all of these dauntless activities the question becomes, can Rooftop and Catfish make it out of Mexico in one piece.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite.

programme.desc: We meet six fearless kid rodeo athletes, ambitiously working towards winning it all in Las Vegas at the end of the year. Bradlee has returned to rough-stock riding after 6 weeks of rehab and must climb back on a bull for the first time. All eyes are on Madison following a life changing, $100,000 win. Koby, a world class calf-roper, is mentored by the legendary Joe Beaver and also recounts a near death experience.

programme.title: Kid Rodeo 第1季
programme.desc: Bradlee prepares for his first day of school and gives his sister a scare. Hagen practices and meditates with Hall-of-Fame bull rider Gary Leffew. It’s a showdown in Edna, Texas between best friends Aspen and Madison as well as the horse whisperer Jayci Lee. All three girls hope to take home the top prize.

programme.title: Kid Rodeo 第1季
programme.sub-title: You Don't Mess with My Boys
programme.desc: Jayci Lee and trusted horse Prince hope to win big money at a Texas ‘Jackpot’ event. Hagen fulfills his sponsorship duties for bull riding legend and sponsor Gary Leffew. Joe Beaver explains his special bond with calf roper Koby. Bradlee, stepping out of his comfort zone, competes against Koby in calf-roping.

programme.title: Kid Rodeo 第1季
programme.sub-title: I Don't Like Talking about Abilene
programme.desc: Hagen makes a strategic blunder and has to live with the consequences. Bradlee’s injured neck requires intense physical therapy. Only hours before leaving for Las Vegas, Jayci Lee receives terrible news that might ruin her chances at victory.

programme.title: Kid Rodeo 第1季
programme.desc: The stage is set as the kids arrive in Las Vegas. Jayci Lee is forced to compete on a horse she’s never ridden after her trusted companion could not make the trip. Meanwhile, Bradlee starts strong but both Madison and Koby have shockingly bad runs as their chances for a title start to dwindle.

programme.title: Kid Rodeo 第1季
programme.sub-title: We Need to Call it a Night
programme.desc: Hagen endures a marathon of waiting and searching for his first bull and begins to question his family’s strategy of competing in multiple events. Without Prince, Jayci’s time in Vegas comes to a close. Aspen continues to outshine her more accomplished best friend Madison. Koby is on the verge of leaving Las Vegas totally empty-handed.

programme.title: Kid Rodeo 第1季
programme.desc: Hagen exhausts himself and begins to break down under the pressure. Aspen looks to take home a huge check at the Mike Johnson World's Tuffest rodeo finals. Bradlee looks to hit a double by making the finals in both bull riding and bareback riding.

programme.title: Kid Rodeo 第1季
programme.desc: Koby gets knocked around and takes his frustration out as a demolition man. Madison fights off flu symptoms and hopes to prove that all the hype was for real. Bradlee bares down with a marathon of re-rides, hoping to claim the top spot in bareback riding.

programme.desc:
Part One of a journey along the Kamilaroi Highway, from Willow Tree to Moree, in New

programme.title: Save This Shark 第1季
programme.desc:
3x World Surf Champion turned wildlife conservationist Mick Fanning teams up with leading experts in new documentary SAVE THIS SHARK. 
Mick Fanning is on a new mission to explore shark conservation. The 3x world surfing champion will hop around the world teaming up with experts and conservationists to uncover the hidden truths about sharks, threats and how to save them from extinction. 
Mick will investigate the issue of sharks versus people and present problems as well as discover the latest technological solutions in how to keep both humans and sharks safe to coexist. Our host has had some incredible achievements throughout his professional career, but one moment stood out to the world live on television in 2015. 
A shark encounter at the J-Bay Open saw Mick Fanning become ‘the guy who punched a shark’. A huge part of saving sharks is convincing people that they need our help and putting aside the fear factor. In Save This Shark, Mick takes this incredible opportunity to go on his ow.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In the South American country of Bolivia, Catfish and Rooftop put their bravery to the test. This duo goes 0 for 2 in the ring testing out their fight skills participating in traditional Tinku fighting and getting smacked down by Bolivia’s Fighting Cholitas. They also face a sketchy ride up death rode just to mountain bike down an equally dangerous path. Catfish has yet to keep a meal down as our bikers try llama brains and Rooftop nearly gets run over as a dancing zebra in the streets. The two top their Bolivian trip off with a trip to the mines on the hunt for silver. With some of the most dangerous activities yet, will Rooftop and Catfish be able to leave Bolivia with just a few bumps and bruises from along the way.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In the most action packed trip yet, Rooftop and Catfish’s trip to Thailand has them face to face with the country’s nature. They wrestle a crocodile, charm a cobra, and get a massage from an elephant that’s somehow more relaxing than the traditional Thai massages they tried out. The two even attempt to catch (cooked) flying chickens on their heads. Things relaxed in Thailand for a moment when the BMX bikers got to balance out this animal packed experience with the spiritual side of the country, each getting Sak Yant, a traditional Thai tattoo. However, the relaxation was short-lived as Catfish and Rooftops’s final battle in Thailand requires them to make it out of a May Thai boxing match alive.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -團團怪獸之謎
programme.desc: When the drains at Pizzamat and Hang 20 start backing up, Alex knows exactly what's caused it – a sewer-gator or maybe a blob monster from outer space. Addison has other ideas however, and is determined to solve the mystery.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -莊嚴的毛毛之謎
programme.desc: When Addison's mom, Detective Patel, comes to the school to talk about her work as a detective, she intrigues Addison and the other kids by revealing that there's an old neighbourhood rumour that a stolen art treasure, the Magnifical Mau-Mau, is hidden in their school.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -桌布
programme.desc: Let's turn the tablecloth into something festive.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -錄音帶
programme.desc: Oo we have found some old gems, let's create something cool and funky out of them.

programme.title: 優可 -優可公園裡的牛仔
programme.desc: When a truckload of animals escapes, Yoko uses her magic to turn the situation into a full-on cowboy and cowgirl adventure.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -大家都愛里歐
programme.desc: Leo feels neglected because of the affection Sprinter is getting from the Bhilkans. Cleopatra takes advantage of the situation and tries to convince Leo that Sprinter doesn't care about her. In reality, Sprinter is planning a surprise party for his best friend.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -轟隆的大爆炸計劃
programme.desc: Hilltown is blossoming with fragrant flowers. Boom has planted all the flowers to cover up his evil plan! He has been hiding stink bombs and now wants to ignite them! Our heroes must find a way, to save the day, and make it possible to breathe peacefully again.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -風暴與海浪
programme.desc: Surfing the waves leads Kit and Mr. Battery into a dangerous storm.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -最大的動物
programme.desc: Mr. Battery collects photos of the largest animals, but he's still missing a photo of the mysterious giant squid.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -傻人節
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, life may be tough, but having fun is also on the agenda! Folly Festival is a carnival where everyone sings and dances, but also has fun trading places. Howler becomes a princess for the day, and Little Lewis a lord.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -荷蘭之旅
programme.desc: On which day in December should people receive their presents? Zoe and Milo are sure that it should be on Christmas, but Alim explains that in some countries, this happens on December 6th. They travel to the Netherlands and learn the story of St. Nicholas.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -西藏之旅
programme.desc: Zoe has started to make a mandala and she needs Milo's beautiful colouring pencils to finish it. That is not a problem for Milo, except that his pencil box is empty! How can Zoe finish her mandala without colouring pencils? A trip to Tibet soon appears to be necessary.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -布吉納法索之旅
programme.desc: In Burkina Faso, our heroes' penfriend Jamal can't wait to introduce Zoe and Milo to his parents, and like Alim, he appears to have several mums and dads. What a mystery.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -沙烏地阿拉伯之旅
programme.desc: Our heroes travel to Saudi Arabia and meet up with Ahed. He knows different ways to move in the desert by day and night, but what he does not know is where his goats have gone. He is going to need some help from his friends.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -話到嘴邊
programme.desc: Maceo has a wonderful idea for the twins' birthday. Unfortunately, he can't put it into words! As a result, everyone gets angry and nobody can make up their mind. The kids will then discover the power of words.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -飛走
programme.desc: Mily and Lola would like to keep the little migratory bird they've just rescued. Their neighbor Dan tells them to let it go once it's able to fly. Mily will understand that migrating is part of nature.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -我的超級英雄生活
programme.desc: Sprinter is doubtful whether he is a good superhero. Fortunately, he has Leo and Bumble to remind him of all the good things he has done since returning to Bhilka.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -朋友卡
programme.desc: A new trend, called 'friend cards' starts on Bhilka. Friend cards have pictures of everyone in Hilltown. The more cards you have, the more friends you have. But this creates a lot of issues between actual friends. So what is the true meaning of friendship.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -電流力學
programme.desc: How do batteries work? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of electricity. Have hands-on fun by making a battery using lemons, and get to know Nikola Tesla, physicist, engineer and inventor, who conceived the modern alternating current supply system.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -環保科學和回收
programme.desc: What's the difference between science and green science? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of renewable energy. Have hands-on fun by making your lettuce sustainable, and get to know Ryoji Noyori, a chemist and great advocate of green chemistry.

programme.title: 44隻貓第一季 -幸運貓奈可
programme.desc: Neko has always been the luckiest cat in the neighborhood, but it looks like now he has lost his luck and his lucky charms: he's a real magnet for trouble! The Buffycats will do whatever they can to help him regain luck and confidence.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -愛波的冬日大衣
programme.desc: Granny has knitted an orange and purple striped coat for Ebb. Flo takes Ebb for a beach walk in the new coat. But it's too hot. Ebb takes a dip. Ebb's coat stretches and stretches. Ebb and Bird find they have a new orange and purple winter blanket.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -撞牆
programme.desc: An 'obstacle course day' in gym class forces the group to reunite and work together. Meanwhile, Kelly has been missing from school, and the gang needs to find her to continue on their mission.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -傳說級的鐵扇
programme.desc: Regal Academy faces Shan Academy in a track-and-field competition. Hawk, Travis, and Astoria are beaten by LingLing, Princess IronFan's granddaughter. Rose must find LingLing's weakness: a love of frilly dresses, to save the day.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -判斷時間
programme.desc: Back in the Middle Ages, methods for telling the time are a far cry from the ones we know today. Church bells and the position of the sun are pretty much all they've got. So inventors are constantly trying to come up with all kinds of new systems to measure time.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -香料熱潮
programme.desc: Spices are a hot item in the Middle Ages! Lord Roach just can't get enough of the stuff! If you can't find the spice you want at the local market stall, it's probably on the other side of the world! And so off goes Little Lewis.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇探險隊的大冒險
programme.desc: While practicing some circus-style tricks, team Doki gets an idea to put on a real circus show for all their friends of the Worldwide Expedition Club. Doki wants it to be amazing, so they set off to a real circus to find out how to put on the Greatest Show on Earth.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -紙莎草紙技術
programme.desc: The sumptuous library of Alexandria was built by the Ptolemies to bring together all the great works of the time. But getting hold of them was no easy matter. Fortunately, with Operation Papyrus, it was no holds barred.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -埃及貓神
programme.desc: Adored in Ancient Egypt, the cat was a real star. But being revered by the population was not exactly a walk in the park. Victims of their own success, cats were sometimes abused. But fortunately, some of them ended up landing on their feet.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -小丑魚與白虎
programme.desc: We follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more clownfish to come. In the meantime, Lin Mao, the white tiger, has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -澳洲
programme.desc: Down Under in Australia: Climbed Sydney Harbor Bridge with local teens, sailing adventure, Sydney Tower Eye Skywalk, cultural exploration in Kakadu National Park, and a daring dip with massive crocs at Crocosaurus Cove. A week of diverse Aussie adventures.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -聖地牙哥
programme.desc: In sunny San Diego: Beach volleyball lesson with local teens, paragliding at Torrey Pines Glider Port, flow riding at Wavehouse, and Olympic archery lessons. A week of thrilling sports and diverse experiences.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -風暴與海浪
programme.desc: Surfing the waves leads Kit and Mr. Battery into a dangerous storm.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -最大的動物
programme.desc: Mr. Battery collects photos of the largest animals, but he's still missing a photo of the mysterious giant squid.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -傻人節
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, life may be tough, but having fun is also on the agenda! Folly Festival is a carnival where everyone sings and dances, but also has fun trading places. Howler becomes a princess for the day, and Little Lewis a lord.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -烏龜
programme.desc: The Nektons explore a floating island and find the pieces of the ancient Lemurian navigation device. But why is this island moving.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -瓶中的星星
programme.desc: Eric learns constellations are groups of stars and that they often have shapes that look like animals, objects, or even people. He makes a lantern that can project the constellation Ursa Major, also known as the Great Bear because it looks like a big bear in the sky.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -無人機
programme.desc: It's Carol's birthday and her famous cake is a hit-except Motor's not there. He's sent a drone instead. Just a phase, says Albert. But when Naomi, Flippy, and Robbie show up as drones too, things spiral fast. The world's going drone, and Carol wants to hide from it all.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -時間靜止
programme.desc: Something's up! Every time Robbie pulls a prank, it gets undone. He soon notices Motor is always nearby-wearing strange bracelets. Curious, Robbie steals them and discovers Motor's secret: he's been stopping time to fix things. Now it's Robbie's turn... for fun.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -宴會
programme.desc: Howler and Dove are invited to Lord Roach's banquet. But banquets come with all kinds of rules and regulations, exposing the greedier guests in the room! Hardened foodies, they indulge in all kinds of scheming.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -花園大災難
programme.desc: When Heni leaves Newts to take care of her garden for a week, Darwin and Newts have to figure out why some of the plants aren't growing so well.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -失敗的烘焙
programme.desc: In a fierce cooking competition, Darwin and Newts learn about the importance of yeast in order to make things rise.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -防止暈眩
programme.desc: Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand investigate diarrhoea. Dr. Xand meets ice-skaing stars to find out why they don't get dizzy when they spin. The Ouch-Mobile is open, and in the emergency room, one patient needs surgery for a broken arm, and another has a painful toe.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -往上流的水
programme.desc: Eric does a magic trick that defies the laws of gravity. Then he learns how to make water flow upwards using a science experiment involving flowers and capillary action.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -堅固的液體
programme.desc: Eric learns that although all matter in the universe exists in three main states – solid, liquid and gas – it's also possible to create a liquid that acts like a solid. He does an experiment to create this substance, called Oobleck.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -黏土腳
programme.desc: A block of flats in Mexico City is in danger: the ground underneath is sinking fast, and the building and its inhabitants are in great danger. The MeteoHeroes must quickly discover what is going on and solve the problem.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -火之叢林
programme.desc: There's a blazing fire in the Amazon rainforest! Only the MeteoHeroes can prevent an environmental catastrophe. While Pluvia and Fulmen can't stop arguing, the fire is getting much worse! Will our heroes learn to work together in time to save the Amazon.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -天啊!天文學
programme.desc: How do rockets manage to defy gravity? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of astronomy. Have hands-on fun by launching your own rocket, and get to know Edwin Hubble, an astronomer, who proved the universe consists of entire galaxies and is expanding.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -紙箱
programme.desc: Hmm all these boxes? What can we do? let's just say we have some 'speedy'' ideas.

programme.title: 動物電視台 -獾
programme.desc: Grandad thinks that the badger on TV is a distant cousin of his. Grey's noisy popcorn eating makes it impossible for Red to watch the show. And despite Tiny Owl's protests, Mommy and Daddy are convinced that the animal they're watching on TV is a panda.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -小鳥紙風箏
programme.desc: What makes a kite stay in the sky? We'll explain all with this playful paper poultry.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -難忘的騎士
programme.desc: Doki figures that to be a knight, all you had to do was joust. Gabi thinks there was more to it than that – but what did you have to do to become a knight? To find out, they head to a medieval festival in England and discover the true meaning of ‘chivalry'.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -巨大錢幣
programme.desc: Why do some coins have holes in them? The team flies to Yap, Micronesia, where coins have holes. But to get one of the valuable ‘rai', they have to make and trade a handmade canoe! After the exchange, the Team learns there's been a big misunderstanding.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -昆蟲
programme.desc: In this episode we explore the wonderful world of insects. At Penn State University, Philippe has a look at the complex societies ants create, learns about the importance of pollinators, and joins a team that studies disease transmission of mosquitoes.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -弗洛里安科勒: 非凡特技撞球員
programme.desc: GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS holder Florian Kohler, also known as 'Venom', demonstrates his precise pool trick-shot skills, sharing the key to his success and what it takes to be a renowned trick-shot performer.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -凱登蓋拉提亞克: 冰上曲棍球奇才
programme.desc: Hockey prodigy Kaden Galatiuk meets Alan Pixsley and shares how he used his razor-sharp precision to achieve the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS title for the most hockey pucks hit into a target on inline skates in one minute.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -火箭與推進力
programme.desc: Emily examines how rockets are made, how they blast off, and how they make their way through the Earth's atmosphere. Plus, she travels to NASA's Wallops Flight Facility for an all-access pass as the crew prepares for the launch of the Antares Rocket.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -防止暈眩
programme.desc: Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand investigate diarrhoea. Dr. Xand meets ice-skaing stars to find out why they don't get dizzy when they spin. The Ouch-Mobile is open, and in the emergency room, one patient needs surgery for a broken arm, and another has a painful toe.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -往上流的水
programme.desc: Eric does a magic trick that defies the laws of gravity. Then he learns how to make water flow upwards using a science experiment involving flowers and capillary action.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -堅固的液體
programme.desc: Eric learns that although all matter in the universe exists in three main states – solid, liquid and gas – it's also possible to create a liquid that acts like a solid. He does an experiment to create this substance, called Oobleck.

programme.title: 體操新星 -任何事都可能發生
programme.desc: A surprising new partnership is announced when coach Nikki decides to pair up Dylan and Nyree. Finn, Kirsten, and Dove have all made life-changing decisions, and Amelie and Phoebe head off to Lillishall for an exclusive Olympic training camp.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -消防員與仿生人
programme.desc: In this episode of Bear Grylls' Becoming Xtraordinary, Sabrina Cohen-Hatton, the most senior ranking firefighter in the UK, and Mark Ormrod, triple amputee and four-time Invictus Games gold medallist, share their incredible stories of resilience.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -旋轉的種子
programme.desc: Eric learns that plants have different ways to make their seeds fly as far away as possible. He makes his own version of the maple seed, which looks like a little paper helicopter.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -到來與離去
programme.desc: Ice dancer Josh has a new partner, Lucy, but they have just weeks to pull off their first public performance. Ice hockey player Rais receives an offer he can't refuse, and figure skaters Josh and Kloe are preparing for a big international competition.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -超級形狀
programme.desc: Eric learns why the triangle is such an important shape for building. He builds a bridge made of straws that is so strong that he can balance several books on it.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -無畏的小小獸醫
programme.desc: The fearless Junior Vets get in the shark tank, and dogs Boris and Red have surgery to help them go walkies. And Jane, the grey seal, is in bad shape after swimming into some fishing wire.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -波羅的海的異象
programme.desc: Ant finds a mysterious box. But a swarm of rabidly voracious “things” emerge, chasing him.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -胰腺與郵差
programme.desc: The Doctors reveal the amazing job your pancreas does, and meet the hospital postman. Dr. Xand investigates how scientists make Bioglass to help doctors mend damaged bones. In the Emergency Room, a patient arrives by air ambulance after falling on a spiky fence.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -離開網格
programme.desc: By using gridlines, an object can be scaled up (magnified) or scaled down (shrunk). In this episode mathemagician Eric shows how to draw a picture of yourself that's completely to scale - even if the original is teeny tiny.

programme.title: 體操新星 -全力以赴
programme.desc: Finn and Kirsten are set for the biggest competition of their lives so far. They have made it into the finals of the Acrobatic World Championships! And now they are up against the best acro gymnasts in the world. Have they got what it takes to win a medal.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -解決問題的人
programme.desc: The Junior Vets need to find out why Tino, the horse, can't walk properly. They help remove a large lump from the throat of Zoe, the Schnauzer dog. And Pollux, the alpaca, is going bald - can the Junior Vets get to the bottom of the problem.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -優勝者是..
programme.desc: The Junior Vets have spent four weeks at Vet School, and it's time to go home. Now they all have a chance to do one last check-up on their grateful patients and say goodbye. But which one of the kids has impressed Paul enough to take the title of Head Vet.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -冰河國家公園
programme.desc: This week we head to the beautiful landscape of Glacier National Park, where Philippe uncovers insect fossils dating back 45 million years, spots wild huckleberries, and joins students participating in a citizen science expedition.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克、地圖和指南針
programme.desc: Eric learns how a compass works and makes one using a needle. He discovers that because of the iron at the centre of the Earth and the way the Earth spins, the magnetic field around our planet acts like a giant magnet.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -大自然教室
programme.desc: In this week's episode Philippe heads to Key Largo to join a high school class getting up close with local sea grass habitats. He later travels to the streams of Pennsylvania to go on a 'Bio-Blitz' surveying aquatic insects.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -令人欽佩的水中上將
programme.desc: Eric learns that even if something is made from a material that is denser or heavier than water, it will float if it has the right shape. He makes a paper boat strong enough to carry toy cars without sinking.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -國王企鵝
programme.desc: Annabelle, the king penguin, is displaying some worrying symptoms. She's waving her head about skywards and Jorge is concerned she may have some neurological problems. Will Annabelle rejoin her friends on the great, icy mound at Loro Parque ever again.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -摩擦力和現實
programme.desc: Eric learns about friction by rolling a ball over different surfaces and rubbing his hands together to warm them up. He discovers there is no friction in space.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -白努利和同伴
programme.desc: Eric learns how the Bernoulli Principle and playing with the flow of air can help him inflate a plastic bag. This same principle explains how airplanes fly, too.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -國際對決
programme.desc: Will captain Emily be fit enough to skate with her team, and what is the surprise in store for Afton? Meanwhile, back in Nottingham, young figure skater Solomon needs to nail his axels if he wants to impress Coach Tamara.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -桌布

programme.title: 體操新星 -友誼的考驗
programme.desc: Best friends Amelie and Phoebe head to Baku to fight against forty-four other European countries to qualify for a spot at the Youth Olympic Games. But if they do manage to qualify, only one gymnast can go. So, with this kind of pressure, can their friendship survive.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -時間緊迫
programme.desc: Today, the Junior Vets have to look after squealing piglets, get uncomfortably close to a giant horse that is having an internal examination, and do health checks on tiny homeless kittens.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -重大手術
programme.desc: The Junior Vets have got one day's experience under their belts. Today a wild boar needs the Junior Vets' help, a tiny dog goes in a massive scanner, and a snotty cow is having heavy surgery.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -超級降落傘
programme.desc: Eric makes a parachute that will slow down a falling egg just enough so it doesn't get smashed when it hits the ground. But first he experiments to figure out the best parachute size. He discovers that NASA also use parachutes to drop robotic probes on to the moon.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -風箏把戲
programme.desc: Eric builds a new kite. He makes sure it is symmetrical – both sides are exactly the same – as that helps kites fly and stay balanced in the air. He learns that there are lots of different types of kites but they all need the wind to fly.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -天然災害
programme.desc: Philippe visits the University of Miami to check out a lab that can simulate a category 5 hurricane. At the University of Reno he explores the so called 'shake table' that designs buildings that can hold up during earthquakes.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -折射上的反射
programme.desc: Eric does a fun experiment to show how refraction plays tricks with our eyes. He learns that when we look at objects, we see the light reflected from them. Because light doesn't travel as well through water as it does through air, things in water look different to us.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -振翅飛舞
programme.desc: Philippe visits the Congaree National Park in South Carolina where he catches and tags local bats. Later, he studies the flight patterns of wood storks and examines the magical transition from caterpillar to butterfly.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -秘密訊息
programme.desc: Eric learns that, with a little science, you can bring out all the colours that make up the black ink in felt tip markers. He separates the colours using chromatography. This gives him a way to write secret messages.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -烏龜菲德莉卡
programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -彩繪白努利
programme.desc: Eric learns how to make an airbrush out of straws. Thanks to the Bernoulli principle, he uses it to create his own work of art.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -三、二、一...升空
programme.desc: The chemical reaction that takes place in the engines of a real rocket produces a large amount of very hot gas that makes the rocket lift off into the sky. Eric mixes baking powder and water to create a chemical reaction strong enough to launch a toy rocket.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -滑冰超能力
programme.desc: Alexia and Kloe are off to London to meet Dr. Xand and the Operation Ouch team to see if a scientist can figure out why they don't get dizzy when they spin. Izzy has a very important speed trial to see if she has what it takes to join the Olympic squad.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -宴會日
programme.desc: It's the day of the gala. As the crowds arrive, there's drama backstage. Will Ella fix her costume in time for her big debut with Adriano? Will Kloe keep her nerves under control and nail her Hungarian performance? A surprising performance leaves everyone speechless.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 野性岬角 -德胡普: 希望之地
programme.desc: The explorers search a colony of rare and endangered vultures that live high in the secluded mountains of the Western Cape. They come upon a refuge for animals, where unexpectedly they catch a glimpse of the largest mammal on the planet.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 野性岬角 -古卡馬: 最後的荒野
programme.desc: While exploring the picturesque Garden Route, the Zebrabus stumbles onto a hidden retreat with some of the highest vegetated dunes in South Africa. They face snakes and other reptiles before venturing out to sea in search of sharks.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -國王企鵝
programme.desc: Annabelle, the king penguin, is displaying some worrying symptoms. She's waving her head about skywards and Jorge is concerned she may have some neurological problems. Will Annabelle rejoin her friends on the great, icy mound at Loro Parque ever again.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -烏龜菲德莉卡
programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.

programme.desc: Our heroes prepare for a sleepover in the HQ, but it seems impossible to divide the space, so they each have a separate bedroom. Alim knows of places where people feel more comfortable sleeping together in the same room. Everyone is soon in Japan for a new adventure.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -馬利之旅
programme.desc: Milo is trying to learn his poem but is having a hard time remembering the words. Alim thinks it is easier to learn something while listening to music! Zoe and Milo do not seem convinced, and Alim decides that only a short break to Mali could change this.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -加納利群島之旅
programme.desc: Is it possible to communicate over a distance with neither telephone nor internet access? A little trip to the Canary Islands could answer the question. With the help of their penfriend Kiko, our friends will learn to use the landscape to communicate with others.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -請注意
programme.desc: Robbie and Flippy are sent to the Principal for messing around, and become subjects of a new experiment in behaviour-control.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -風箏把戲
programme.desc: Eric builds a new kite. He makes sure it is symmetrical – both sides are exactly the same – as that helps kites fly and stay balanced in the air. He learns that there are lots of different types of kites but they all need the wind to fly.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -歡樂下雨天
programme.desc: After a day of mud sliding, the kids have to problem solve when heavy rain endangers some of the Kiwifruit Valley creatures.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -紙飛機的難題
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts learn about the different shapes of paper planes, and then have to help Heni rescue Burpee from the top of a tree.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -寫程式和編碼
programme.desc: How did people compute before the invention of computers? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of computing. Have hands-on fun by making your own abacus, and get to know Ada Lovelace, the first computer programmer before the invention of computers.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -瘋狂的催化劑

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -無頭獵人之謎
programme.desc: Addison has to solve the mystery of what's making scary sounds after Donnie convinces the other kids on an Ayrton Rangers camping trip that a mythical spook called the Headless Haunter is wandering through the park.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -惡毒的蚊子之謎
programme.desc: When swarms of mosquitoes mysteriously descend on the park, the kids' summer movie night is in danger of being cancelled unless Addison and her friends can figure out a way to stop them.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -迷宮之旅
programme.desc: After Doki tells the story of Theseus and the labyrinth, Mundi boasts about her natural sense of direction. Gabi thinks Mundi relies on her ability to fly! To prove her skill, Mundi suggests they visit a hedge maze in Cumbria, England.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇的海豚
programme.desc: Fico has decided that the ideal pet for him is a dolphin. At first, everyone finds this ridiculous, but then gets excited. The team flies to the coast of Australia to find one. After all, why can't Fico have a dolphin.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -咖啡濾紙
programme.desc: Who says coffee is the only thing filters are used for? See how we turn this day to day object into something fun.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -粉蠟筆
programme.desc: Colouring isn't the only thing these crayons are good at! Join Hepi and Briko as they blow your mind with creative and colourful DIYs.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -大猩猩醫腳

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -騎士們

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -奇特的硬幣之謎
programme.desc: Addison and Alex dig up what they think is an Ancient Roman coin in the community garden – then have a mystery to solve when it unexpectedly disappears.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -搶先報導

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -地球日
programme.desc: Let's celebrate this wonderful planet we call home! Make sure to remember our 3 Rs.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -麵粉
programme.desc: Ahh something smells so good, what is it? Oh it's Hepi and Briko's fresh new ideas! What are they up to now.

programme.title: 優可 -小小事物
programme.desc: When the kids lose a toy, Yoko shrinks them down to toy size so they can find it.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -超大號里歐
programme.desc: Sprinter feels bad that Leo is so small. He builds her a machine that alters the size of things. Leo is, after all, fine being small. Sprinter could learn by looking at things from another perspective.

programme.desc: When Leo disappears, Bumble has to help Sprinter find her. All traces lead to Cleopatra, but she won`t admit anything. Soon, Bumble goes missing too! Sprinter realises that the only solution is to let himself get caught.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -鑽油平台
programme.desc: A visit to an oil platform leads to an accident that Kit and Mr. Battery must set right.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -海嘯
programme.desc: Kit and Mr. Battery fight the albatross for the stolen safety buoys.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -伊朗之旅

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -午夜的12聲鐘響

programme.title: 深海大探險 -波羅的海的異象

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -往上流的水

programme.desc: When a raging river moves the bridge, Darwin and Newts must learn about counterweights so they can build a crane to reach out and retrieve it.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -抓鬼記

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -大自然教室

programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.desc: Viola Brand is an artistic cyclist from Germany who has won national and European championships with her gymnastic abilities on a bicycle. She holds the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS title for the most 360-degree rotations, standing on bicycle handlebars in one minute.

programme.desc: How can we prove plants and flowers drink water? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of botany. Have hands-on fun by making a rainbow-coloured flower, and get to know J.C. Bose, an amazing polymath who pioneered studies into the nature of plants.

programme.desc: When Teresa learns about love, she decides that an extreme version of this silly emotion might be used to render humans so love-struck they're useless.

programme.title: 動物電視台 -北極海鸚
programme.desc: Franky thinks the puffins on TV must be robots, and Tiny Owl worries that he might not be the cutest critter in town anymore as Mommy and Daddy fall in love with the puffins on TV. Grandad Badger tells Binah about the time he was a circus clown.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -旋轉藝術器
programme.desc: Rotate to create with this crafty contraption.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -松露危機
programme.desc: What are truffles, anyway? And if they're so rare, how do we find some? Doki, Gabi, Mundi and Fico head to the Tuscany region of Italy, to borrow a comically lazy truffle hunting dog, and try to snuffle up a new truffle.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -愛爾蘭運勢說
programme.desc: When Anabella breaks a mirror, she worries that she's going to have bad luck, and refuses to go through with her Irish dancing recital! But are superstitions real? They travel to Blarney, Ireland to try to find a four-leaf clover to turn her luck around.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -微觀世界
programme.desc: Philippe heads to the University of Texas to break down the microscopic world of sand and understand how microscopic science plays a role in researching fire ants. At the University of Pennsylvania he learns all about soil.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -亞歷克斯古爾丁與吉米崔: 力量二人組的壯舉
programme.desc: Ninja warrior Jimmy and fitness fanatic Alex reveal how they worked together to achieve the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS title for the most consecutive double high-five push-ups! The powerful duo meets Aisheshek Magauina and shares what it takes to work as a team.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -米哈埃拉布林佐尤: 折彎平底鍋的鐵手金剛
programme.desc: Mihaela Brinzoiu is a formidable strongwoman who holds the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS title for the most frying pans rolled in one minute, achieving ten successfully rolled-up pans. She meets Alan Pixsley and shares her story of becoming a strongwoman.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -太空精彩瞬間20強
programme.desc: Xploration Outer Space names “The Top 20 Greatest Moments in Space: Caught on Video.” These are the most breathtaking, the most dramatic, the most important and the most fun images captured by the space program from here in our solar system to the galaxies beyond.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -咳嗽實驗精彩回顧
programme.desc: In the last episode, the doctors look back at their favourite bits of the season - including what happens when you cough and the life-changing operation that allows someone to hear for the very first time. There's a new mind-bending trick, and the Ouch-Mobile is open.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -超級形狀
programme.desc: Eric learns why the triangle is such an important shape for building. He builds a bridge made of straws that is so strong that he can balance several books on it.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -驚人的神經元
programme.desc: Eric learns that neurons are the brain's tiny building blocks. He does an experiment to show what they are and how they work. He is surprised to learn that giraffes have neurons that are five metres long.

programme.title: 體操新星 -跌落的恐懼
programme.desc: It's competition time for the acrobatic gymnasts, who are all heading off to the Scottish Championships. The stakes are high for both teams. But will Finn and Kirsten be able to hold their nerve and perform a clean routine.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -發明家與叛逆者
programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary presented by Bear Grylls, inventor and most cited engineer in history Robert Langer and recipient of the Nobel Prize for chemistry, Frances Arnold, reflect on their award-winning careers in science.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -折射上的反射
programme.desc: Eric does a fun experiment to show how refraction plays tricks with our eyes. He learns that when we look at objects, we see the light reflected from them. Because light doesn't travel as well through water as it does through air, things in water look different to us.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -渴求速度
programme.desc: All eyes are on speed skater Izzy who has one last chance to prove she has got what it takes to represent Team Great Britain at the Olympics. And ice dancer Ella swaps her ice skates for pedals at the velodrome.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -風箏把戲
programme.desc: Eric builds a new kite. He makes sure it is symmetrical – both sides are exactly the same – as that helps kites fly and stay balanced in the air. He learns that there are lots of different types of kites but they all need the wind to fly.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -來抓我
programme.desc: Today, the Junior Vets meet some feisty meerkats who need their claws trimmed, but first, they've got to catch them. Ashanti, the elephant, gets his feet and tail cleaned. Johnny and Inel discover what you get when you cross a lion and a tiger.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -當心哨兵
programme.desc: A mysterious, ancient temple beneath the sea has been hidden for centuries. The Nektons discover there is a very good reason for that.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -醫生警報
programme.desc: The Doctors take a dip in a jelly pool to show how the cells in your body work! We find out how to deal with a head injury in First Aid, and discover why babies need more sleep than Dr Xand in Ouch Baby.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -正四面體的樹
programme.desc: In this episode Eric tries to solve an age-old mystery: How should four trees be placed if the distances between them need to be the same? To find an answer, Eric uses three-dimensional objects called ‘tetrahedrons'.

programme.title: 體操新星 -給我自信
programme.desc: New Acro duo Dove and Nyree struggle to make their partnership work while rhythmic sensation Mimi sets everyone spinning in the Gym Stars Challenge.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -會唱歌的貓
programme.desc: A shy antelope needs surgery, while a cute orphaned fox cub gets checked over. Johnny and Inel discover a singing cat. And a gull tries to fly free again after being hit by a car.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -解開謎團
programme.desc: The cute homeless dogs are looking for new owners, and Johnny and Inel solve the mysteries of goats that climb trees and dogs with unusual toilet habits! The Junior Vets are trying to figure out how to give a big brown bear its medicine.

Single and stepping back into the spotlight on her own terms, she's ready to unveil RZ 2.0 to the world. She's determined to build her future in the land of fame and fortune.

programme.desc: Masters of Cantonese Cuisine is a documentary on Lingnan (Guangdong) delicacies culture, originally created by Shenzhen Satellite TV. This is a brief history of food belonging to the Greater Bay Area, a history of customs and culture that belongs exclusively to Guangdong. The program focus on the local Guangdong delicacies, and led by a “delicacy searcher”, walking through streets in search of local specialities, visiting masters of Cantonese cuisines, and sharing unique tasting commentaries. In the meantime, the reflection on delicacies would be brought back to live studio, and two observers who are proficient in Cantonese cuisine cultures will have chats on tasting. From a spoon and a drop, it will extend to the taste of life and origin of culture embedded in the delicacies.

programme.title: 甜到入心
programme.desc: 疫情下改變了很多人的飲食習慣，除了自煮之外，網購食品更成習慣。今集Crystal找來閨密Hillary同思朗，齊齊試食網購外賣送上門的中式糖水、香港少見的法式甜點同媲美酒店級數的靚靚蛋糕。Kendy則帶大家去中環一幢4層高的日式古著咖啡店。.

programme.title: 一秒廚神

時光正好
programme.sub-title: 第二十五集：李靜帶着行李離開
programme.desc: 早上夢安發現李靜已經帶着行李離開，她責怪李臨不該這樣對姐姐，傷了她的心。夢安打電話給李靜，李靜說她想回家看看歐陽。地產公司外的一家咖啡廳，婉真把自己準備好的客戶資料留給了菲菲，讓菲菲做好房屋銷售.

programme.title: 念
programme.desc: 器官捐贈微電影《念》，講述一位母親為離世兒子捐出器官時，所經歷嘅思念與抉擇，以及捐出兒子器官後，見證到受贈者與家屬重獲新生而萌生的全新體會。希望透過微電影鼓勵大眾踏出重要一步，支持器官捐贈，讓受贈者及他們的家人得到第二人生.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.sub-title: 大潭郊野公园的日与夜
programme.desc: 人生活的地方，可以和自然环境靠近。这是大潭郊野公园的其中一个特色。. 其实，大潭郊野公园位于港岛东部，面积占香港岛的五分之一。内有四个水塘，由一条大潭水务文物径连系。. 沿着文物径，当中不少的水务设施，都已经被评定为法定古迹。例如由花岗石建造的石桥和水坝，都有过百年历史.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 無極飛行
programme.sub-title: 無極飛行第九集：澳洲 - 灌木林機師
programme.desc: Clark Butson在澳洲的乾旱沙漠中創建了一家航空公司，希望連結位於國家西部皮爾布拉省的偏遠社群。在這裏，飛機是與外界連繫的唯一方式。C lark的任務種類繁多：拯救行動、搭載學生、補給、礦場員工換班、探訪原住民社區等等。Clark亦會協助牧民趕牛。他們要在數百平方公里的灌木叢中，將數千隻牛集合在一起，是個非常大規模的行動。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2023年11月20日 星期一晚上10時30分 Clark Butson founded an airline in the heart of Australia's arid desert. Its goal: to unite the isolated communities of the province of Pilbara, in the west of the country. Here, the airplane is the only link with the rest of the world. And Clark has a lot to do to on his missions. Rescues, student transportation, supplies, rotations between mines, visiting aboriginal communities. Clark also helps farmers during "mustering," a massive operation to gather their thousands of cattle scattered over hundreds of kilometers in the bush. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2023.11.20 MON 10:30pm.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2 - 難忘的一天
programme.desc: 杏鮑仔有一種不祥的預感。他總覺得自己忘了某件至關重要的事。當記憶的碎片終於拼湊完整，他明白了那股不安的源頭——菇菇鎮即將遭受一群飢餓木蟲的侵襲！築起防禦工程！我們必須拯菇菇鎮.

programme.title: 紅粉緋緋與彼得叻叻豬
programme.desc: A)緋緋被挑選在全校音樂會中，擔任她班別的獨唱代表。她興奮得不斷地練習，但在表演當天早上卻發現失了聲，聲音變得沙啞，她能否在音樂會中表演呢？. B)緋緋、莉莉及彼得原本計劃跟心愛的娃娃一起到公園爬山。但莉莉的娃娃的手臂卻破爛了，緋緋自告奮勇幫忙修補，最後兩人更變身成紅粉村的娃娃醫生，在後園的樹屋中開了娃娃醫院，修補破爛的娃娃。可憐彼得一等再等，都無法出發去爬山。. 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2021年4月25日 星期日 上午9時00分 (重播) 2021年4月25日 星期日 下午6時30分 (重播) 2021年5月1日 星期六 下午6時30分 (網上重溫) 至 2022年4月24日 星期日 . A) Pinkalicious is chosen to sing a solo in a class concert. She practices and practices to make sure she gets the solo just right, but on the morning of the performance she discovers she’s lost her voice! How will she be able to sing?. B) Pinkalicious, Jasmine and Peter love playing with their dolls. When one of their dolls gets hurt, the fun doesn’t end – instead, the game changes to playing doctor! Soon, Pinkalicious and Jasmine find themselves taking care of all the dolls in Pinkville while Peter feels a little left out. . Channel: RTHK 31 Time: (First Run) 2021.4.25 SUN 9:00am (Re-run) 2021.4.25 SUN 6:30pm (Re-run) 2021.5.1 SAT 6:30pm (On-line Catch-up) Till 2022.4.24 SUN.

programme.title: 冰球少年
programme.desc: 沈冰冰惦記趙大龍入隊與冷靖對質後穿幫，又聯繫不上陳徹，一氣之下假扮外賣員找到陳徹，一番交流，沈冰冰覺得這件事可以被蒙混過去。冷靖偷點外賣被陳宥斌發現，並指責陳宥斌的訓練方針不科學。陳宥斌與隊員們進行比試，與隊員們打成一片。沈舟舟確診焦慮症.

programme.sub-title: 第十五集: 總行偏私郝偉負責的支行
programme.desc: 莫惜君帶著花羽銀行的外方領導與林強談判，對方再次詢問，這項合作到底有沒有得到聯眾銀行高層領導的支持。總行多次給郝偉負責的支行優惠政策，在行政上特事特辦，導致兩家支行位於同一條街，卻給客戶提供不同的收益，引起其他支行對郝偉的不滿.

programme.title: 前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第十六集: 詐騙貸款與董事長邢禮有關
programme.desc: 錢才的太太發現了錢才留下的文件，立即去找林強，林強查看了，發現汶琥集團的貸款竟然是與董事長邢禮有關!邢禮親自來到龍源給兩家支行開會，郝偉強調龍源不該存在惡性競爭，應該合並兩家支行，林強不服，認為還沒到三個月的期限，應當遵守信用。祝豐山當眾支持林強.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 於本集中，我們會盤點動物王國中最具魅力的野生動物家族。從人類的表親——靈長類寶寶，到最可愛迷人的貓科動物家族，再到地球上色彩繽紛的鳥類家族。跟我們一起探索這些不可思議動物的生活點滴吧.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊

programme.title: 31看世界 - 大熊貓雲川和鑫寶
programme.desc: 雄性大熊貓雲川今年5歲，必殺技是「吃」，最愛躺着吃，沒有任何一根筍能逃出雲川的嘴巴。住在雲川隔壁的是4歲的雌性大熊貓鑫寶，因為需要大量啃食竹子，一個領地裏，多一張嘴都可能導致食物不夠，所以大熊貓有極強的領地意識.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 大熊貓雲川和鑫寶
programme.desc: 自1996年，大熊貓白雲入住加州聖地亞哥動物園20多年，牠以其獨特魅力迅速成為動物園罕見的鎮園之寶。無疑備受期待的雲川和鑫寶，也將成為聖地亞哥新的超級明星。為了迎接熊貓的到來，聖地亞哥動物園正在改造原有的熊貓館.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 本集從定義何謂「冒險」出發，探討從離開舒適圈、計算風險到追尋自我的心理歷程。節目透過分享各人深刻的冒險故事——從荒野露營、挑戰畏高到孤身赴日發展，剖析冒險中的得失與自我發現。我們更以神奇的魔術表演為引，反思當「知曉秘密」後，人如何持續追尋生命的驚喜與真實。最終，我們將冒險的意義從宏大的生命轉折，延伸至日常中不計劃的旅行與微小突破。. 主持:. 陳葦璇(歌手). 林家濠(哲學講師). 李澄琳(澳洲註冊營養師). 馮孟成(魔術師).

programme.title: 時光正好
programme.sub-title: 第二十六集：錢副總突襲婉真
programme.desc: 錢副總突襲婉真，路過的俞辰挺身而出，救下婉真。婉真深表感激。俞辰告訴婉真，為了安全，建議她在陽台上掛幾件男士衣服，婉真笑了出來。許夢安回到家，看到冰箱裏李靜大姐包的幾百個餛飩，頗感溫暖.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解4
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解4》邀請了香港觀鳥會高級項目主任梁浩男，分享有關秧鷄的生態知識。本集以白胸苦惡鳥、紫水鷄和鳳頭麥鷄作例子，並利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索秧鷄的外貌特徵、食性、以及生活習性.

programme.title: 灣區夢成真
programme.desc: 高中組（趙聿修紀念中學）學生設計的大灣區行程，開展Day 1與Day 2行程，探索廣州佛山文化與科技，通過遊戲與資訊展現大灣區的傳統與現代.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第六集：劉銘巨額債務令羅英子崩潰
programme.desc: 王大福案的受害人家屬因未能獲判賠償，到大正律師事務所大吵大鬧，要求退款。為了不想失去這宗案件，薜律師和陳碩表示會為他們找出真兇，爭取賠償。另一邊，羅英子把公婆住的房子賣給了周老闆，並要求他們搬離房子，然而此時又再得悉劉銘在外還借了巨額債務，頓時崩潰.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 大熊貓雲川和鑫寶
programme.desc: 雄性大熊貓雲川今年5歲，必殺技是「吃」，最愛躺着吃，沒有任何一根筍能逃出雲川的嘴巴。住在雲川隔壁的是4歲的雌性大熊貓鑫寶，因為需要大量啃食竹子，一個領地裏，多一張嘴都可能導致食物不夠，所以大熊貓有極強的領地意識.

programme.title: 動物童萌

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 海鸚們在雪地裡發現了一輛被棄置的雪橇後，為了誰人先乘坐而爭吵起來。可是，他們並不知道還有其他「人」也想玩這個雪橇⋯⋯.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊

programme.title: 冰球少年
programme.desc: 陳徹和沈舟舟得到沈冰冰在酒吧喝醉的消息，同時趕往酒吧，陳徹先到，正帶沈冰冰向外走，遇到了趕來的沈舟舟。車上，沈冰冰半夢半醒說出心裡話，陳徹和沈舟舟尷尬地聽著。沈舟舟為讓陳徹寬心，主動緩和關係。冷靖和趙大龍意外被鎖在冰場。陳徹和沈舟舟矛盾加深.

programme.sub-title: 第十七集: 林強與銀行創辦人見面表達信念

programme.title: 前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第十八集：邢禮和陳行遠撕破臉
programme.desc: 林強請邱之彰去參加簽約儀式。邱老認為不符合規矩，林強說出和花羽銀行的合作有些激進，但只要在規則的範圍之下，可以開創金融界的新領域。邢禮找陳行遠談話，兩人徹底撕破臉。邢禮希望兩人各退一步，然而陳行遠沒有收手的打算，他篤定邢禮的手不乾淨.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊

programme.desc: 在小西瓜百天宴當天，許父也來到夢心所在的月子會所為她慶祝。可惜熊熊生病去了醫院，本應熱鬧的百天宴變得了無生氣。夢心看到父親蒼老的樣子，夢心忍不住痛哭。許父雖說不出話，但仍努力安撫女兒，不希望她再自責.

programme.title: Dream Chasers
programme.desc: 蕭欣浩，中文系博士兼講師，專研飲食文化。他中學會考得六分，但自小愛吃愛煮，對美食的觸覺可謂滿分。為了追尋飲食夢，他年輕時曾經當法國餐廳廚師，但他的追夢歷程並不止於此。當了廚師一年後，他決定重投校園，花十年時間當上中文系博士，其後鑽研飲食文化及歷史，將飲食夢的舞台轉移至校園，甚至延伸至社區，透過電視節目、講座、專欄、著書等，實現夢想2.0 —傳承飲食文化。. 這一集，我們一邊跟著蕭博士吃吃喝喝，一邊投入他的飲食文化多元宇宙.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第七集：方麗虹成為羅英子代理律師
programme.desc: 羅英子再發現劉銘把她住的房子抵押給銀行及欠下巨額貸款。羅英子來到方麗虹辦公室，請求方麗虹能為她這件案子出山，方麗虹最終答應。然而，韓之通反對，認為應該開除羅英子。此時，王大福親自來感謝羅英子幫他查明案件，羅英子從中得知韓之通收下了王大福的感謝費.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 為人民服務

programme.title: 31看世界 - 魅力阿聯酋
programme.sub-title: 第二集：多元化的繽紛魅力
programme.desc: 因為得天獨厚的地理位置，阿聯酋在歷史上始終與世界保持著貿易往來。今天，它與全球的聯繫更日益緊密。. 隨著阿聯酋航空業的發展，越來越多的外籍人士來到阿聯酋生活，多元文化在此彙聚。法國之外的全球唯一一所盧浮宮博物館帶來了頂級文化盛宴，F1大獎賽等世界級體育賽事讓這裡充滿速度與激情。. 引入機器人騎手參賽的駱駝比賽，充滿包容性的傳統樂器烏德琴，使阿聯酋在擁抱全球多元文化的同時，始終傳承著自己的文化根基。. 中阿兩國在歷史上就已經開始交往，如今，在兩國建交40周年之際，兩國合作項目如雨後春筍般湧現。在密切的交流合作中，中國和阿聯酋正攜手開創全新的未來.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: 一位曾任職管理層的職場女性羅欣妮(Annie)，因後天眼疾導致視力僅餘一成，被迫在黑暗中重新尋找人生與事業的方向。然而，漫長的求職路上，社會的刻板印象與不理解曾讓她感到束手無策，直到她遇見了現職的人力資源服務公司，這個將共融視為公司文化的企業，令她成功重返職場。. 吳海昕(Sofiee)將在 Annie 的帶領下，親身體驗視障人士學習職場技能的挑戰，並深入了解 Annie 如何從失落中尋求支援、重拾職場價值的心路歷程。這不單是關於 Annie 個人堅韌成長的故事，更是一場關於企業如何帶頭推廣職場接納、發掘潛能、並在業界樹立共融典範的深刻對話，透過實際行動，打破職場藩籬.

programme.title: 綠惜見未來
programme.desc: 2023 marked the 10th anniversary of the Belt and Road Initiative, with Hong Kong actively stepping up its role to showcase its unique strengths to Belt and Road countries. Chief Executive John Lee led a delegation to the Middle East, signing 13 memorandums of understanding with Middle Eastern nations to promote the development of green and smart cities in the region. . The government is leading efforts to open up the Middle Eastern market, encouraging Hong Kong businesses to seize opportunities in the region’s green economy. Jeffrey Lam, Executive Council member and founder of the non-profit Hong Kong Ambassadors Club, along withPatrick Tsang, organized two delegations of businesses from various sectors to meet with Middle Eastern political and business leaders. These exchanges resulted in several memorandums of understanding being signed between Hong Kong companies and their Middle Eastern counterparts, including Grade A Energy Limited, Green Mondy, and Rice Robotics, opening the door for green businesses to enter the Middle Eastern market, and sharing Hong Kong’s green technologies with local enterprises. . Meanwhile, Hong Kong Science Park has played a key role in opening up the Middle Eastern market, leading eight tech companies to participate in a large-scale technology exhibition in Saudi Arabia. This showcased Hong Kong’s strengths in green technology. Among them, a startup focused on electric vehicle charging solutions connected with potential local customers during the event, strengthening its confidence in exploring opportunities in the region. . What challenges and opportunities have they faced while venturing into the Middle Eastern green market.

programme.title: 縣委大院
programme.desc: 梅曉歌召開醫改專項調度會，直面醫改中沒改好、越改越差的具體問題。林志為書記主持圍爐夜話，幫村民解決問題。長嶺村陸續有村民生病，林志為是水質污染的問題，測出水裡的重金屬嚴重超標，涉及到九原縣昶勝礦業的污染問題.

programme.title: 縣委大院
programme.desc: 梅曉歌為村民檢查身體，同時去找曹立新解決昶勝礦業的污染問題。曹立新卻因為昶勝礦業能成為市內第一家上市企業，不肯解決問題。林志為走訪了礦產企業所在的九原縣蓮花鄉，瞭解了鄉民受污染所害的情況，建議長嶺村的村民們聯合起來，以集體訴訟的方式獲取應得的賠償.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 為人民服務

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 於城市之中，其實一直有人以「繪畫」作為記錄。這行為並非為了展覽，而是為了理解一個地方，並確認自身的存在。當我們停下腳步，以眼與手描繪城市時，所描繪的或許不僅僅是建築，更是我們與城市之間的關係。本集將以城市寫生為起點，重新觀看城市，探討人與空間的倫理關係。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 黃仲遠(註冊組織心理學家). 李思汝(視覺藝術家). 雷焯諾(插畫師). #城市寫生#眾生相*人與空間#在場實踐#城市動態.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
演藝盛薈：粵劇 紅鬃烈馬
programme.desc: 粵劇《紅鬃烈馬》改編自京劇經典骨子老戲，具有深厚的群眾基礎，劇中《三擊掌》《平貴別窯》《平貴回窯》等經典名段，最為觀眾所熟知。故事講述丞相王允的三女王寶釧，與貧寒的薛平貴之間的愛情故事。故事傳遞了重誠信、守節義的傳統美德。. . 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2026年2月14日 星期六 下午3時 . The story chronicles the romance between the Wang Bao-chuan (王寶釧), and the impoverished Xue Ping-gui (薛平貴). It conveys traditional virtues of integrity and fidelity. . Channel: RTHK 31 Time: (First Run) 2026.02.14 SAT 3:00 pm .

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 將廣闊國土上的陽光、勁風與江河之力轉化為驅動未來的綠色動能，用沙漠陽光點亮萬家燈火，讓工廠流淌綠色電流。當「啟航號」風車的巨臂劃破長空，捕獲大自然之力，加上「零碳」工廠在黑暗中高效運轉，我們看見清潔能源正在重塑中國製造的基因.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: Stephanie Villaeba Gurung 今年26歲，是在香港出生的尼泊爾和菲律賓混血兒。Stephanie爸爸從小安排她就讀本地學校的華語班。大學期間，她修讀英語語言文學，這段經歷加深了她對文化研究和寫作的興趣。現在她在不同學校教文化及語言課題，還和其他多元族裔朋友一齊以廣東話主持播客節目。. 今集Stephanie會和大家分享自己對身份認同和多元文化的感受。還會和主持Carmen、Vita一齊來個美食比賽.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解4
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解4》邀請了香港觀鳥會高級項目主任梁浩男，分享有關秧鷄的生態知識。本集以白胸苦惡鳥、紫水鷄和鳳頭麥鷄作例子，並利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索秧鷄的外貌特徵、食性、以及生活習性.

programme.title: 灣區夢成真
programme.desc: 高中組Day 3行程，聚焦探索農業與生命科學創新；初中組與高中組學生分享感受，總結大灣區文化之旅.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 感激有你
programme.sub-title: 感激有你 - 區區有愛
programme.desc: 幫助獨居長者換燈膽、替行動不便的街坊取藥、教婆婆用手機與孫仔視像通話. . . .這些點點滴滴的舉手之勞，對有需要的街坊來說，就是生活上的及時雨。當打風落雨、突發事故，他們更會即時化身「社區第一防線」，為街坊解決困難，他們就是由義工組成的社區關愛隊；他們用腳行遍社區，用眼觀察需要，進駐18區的每個角落，當街坊有需要的時候，他們就會出動。今集主持會帶大家去了解屯門友愛邨關愛隊的日常工作情況.

programme.title: 守藝薪傳：名家導讀
programme.desc: 本集守藝薪傳名家導賞版，麥勁生教授將帶大家欣賞中國傳統文化：粵劇和揚琴。. 粵劇是融合南北藝術精華的傳統表演藝術，自明清時期的廣州發展至香港，成為人類非物質文化遺產。芳雪瑩從中學英文老師轉型為粵劇導師，專心培育後進，徒弟張雅泳五歲開始習藝，十歲即成文武生，多次獲獎，並致力於傳承粵劇。師徒兩代以粵劇藝術啟發年輕一代，開創香港粵劇的未來。. 揚琴是西方引入的民族樂器，在廣東音樂史上扮演重要角色。賴應斌六歲習琴，成為首位獲得揚琴演奏碩士的本土音樂家，對揚琴教育貢獻良多。徒弟蕭俊賢已獲音樂碩士，並組成樂團「伍人粵」，用創新手法延續廣東音樂的傳統.

programme.title: 我親愛的 Donovan
programme.desc: Donovan在雨中告白，兩人初吻定情。然而，Jessica以姐姐Maria的線索為誘餌，Donovan為獲取信息與她發生關係。Pam表面強裝大度，內心醋意翻騰、痛苦不堪。同時，母親以自身被外國戀人拋棄並令家族蒙羞的往事，痛陳利害，懇求Pam為外公的健康著想，結束這段關係。剛嚐到甜蜜的Pam，瞬間被推入忠於愛情與守護家庭的殘酷抉擇中，陷入撕裂與掙扎.

programme.title: 周末大電影：忘不了
programme.desc: 小慧（張柏芝飾）性格反叛倔強，自小與父母疏離，因經常坐同一條小巴線而認識了小巴司機阿文（古天樂飾）。豈料二人正在籌備婚禮期間，阿文突然遇上車禍去世，留下與前妻所生的兒子樂樂…小慧不單不理家人反對，還負上養育樂樂的責任，更將阿文的小巴翻新，當上小巴司機。大輝（劉青雲飾）性格率直善良，由於他目睹阿文車禍，因而對小慧付予同情，屢次見她被行家欺負都出手協助，久而久之對她產生愛意，小慧得到大輝支持後，漸漸堅強地面對每個難關，可惜的是小慧對阿文始終念念不忘.

programme.title: 綠惜見未來
programme.desc: 2023 marked the 10th anniversary of the Belt and Road Initiative, with Hong Kong actively stepping up its role to showcase its unique strengths to Belt and Road countries. Chief Executive John Lee led a delegation to the Middle East, signing 13 memorandums of understanding with Middle Eastern nations to promote the development of green and smart cities in the region. . The government is leading efforts to open up the Middle Eastern market, encouraging Hong Kong businesses to seize opportunities in the region’s green economy. Jeffrey Lam, Executive Council member and founder of the non-profit Hong Kong Ambassadors Club, along withPatrick Tsang, organized two delegations of businesses from various sectors to meet with Middle Eastern political and business leaders. These exchanges resulted in several memorandums of understanding being signed between Hong Kong companies and their Middle Eastern counterparts, including Grade A Energy Limited, Green Mondy, and Rice Robotics, opening the door for green businesses to enter the Middle Eastern market, and sharing Hong Kong’s green technologies with local enterprises. . Meanwhile, Hong Kong Science Park has played a key role in opening up the Middle Eastern market, leading eight tech companies to participate in a large-scale technology exhibition in Saudi Arabia. This showcased Hong Kong’s strengths in green technology. Among them, a startup focused on electric vehicle charging solutions connected with potential local customers during the event, strengthening its confidence in exploring opportunities in the region. . What challenges and opportunities have they faced while venturing into the Middle Eastern green market.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 尾巴會說話
programme.desc: 在光明與黑暗交疊的世界裡，導盲犬是視障人士忠心的守護者，牽引他們走過人生的荊棘滿途，編織成一個關於忠誠和希望的故事。. 拉布拉多犬Gabe從出生開始，他的生命註定不凡，經過嚴謹的篩選，他被選中成為導盲犬，開啟了他的使命之旅。本片將會由她從幼犬到受訓練開始記錄，見證Gabe如何學會陪伴視障人士，成為他們生活中的光明使者。過程中，Gabe不僅接受了服從、導航、危險識別等複雜技能的培訓，更經歷了與訓練員之間深厚感情的建立，見證人犬情誼溫暖人心。. 隨著Gabe的訓練接近尾聲，他即將步入畢業典禮，與自己的視障夥伴進行配對。從陌生到熟悉，他們的每一次接觸、每一刻相處，都在重新定義信任與依靠的意義。視障人士的故事令人心碎，他們曾因失去視力而對生活感到絕望，然而導盲犬的出現，讓他們重新擁抱人生。冷冰冰的手杖被溫暖的毛髮代替。每一次步伐的穩定，每一次停下的等待，在導盲犬的陪伴下，視障人士重新追尋失去的夢想，見證人犬情深，便能光明同行的故事.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 但是還有書籍 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第三集：繪本中的奇妙世界
programme.desc: 《繪本中的奇妙世界》從繪本作者和推廣人的視角探索成人與兒童世界的連結。蔡臯以《荒原狐精》獲得中國繪本國際大獎，將中國民間文化與童謠語言結合，表達鄉愁。熊亮用現代繪本講述中國故事，展現古典文學的影響。推廣人粲然與孩子們共讀，傳遞童書的力量。她們共同守護童心，潤澤孩子們的心靈，將成人世界的祝福帶入童話中.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 但是還有書籍 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第四集：設計師的紙上王國
programme.desc: 《設計師的紙上王國》從裝幀設計師的角度探討書籍形式與內容的美感。寧成春見證了中國書籍設計的變革，設計內斂而富有情感。獨立設計師何浩在藝術書籍設計中記錄藝術發展，賦予書籍更多意義。海外藝術家薄英與張充和的情誼促使他用中國元素設計書籍，尋找適合漢字書法的英文字體，堅信各種材料都能創造書籍，回應人的感官和想象.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.desc: 主持雅各．艾德格與阿爾瓦羅．費南迪斯相聚於利馬，一同發掘南美洲精彩國度—秘魯—的風景、聲音與味道。他們在秘魯的首都利馬，尋找經典傳統，品嚐著名美食，並搜尋秘魯的音樂傳奇。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年3月26日 星期二晚，10時30分 秘魯 - 利馬 (4K). . Hosts Alvaro Fernandez and Jacob Edgar meet up in Lima to explore the different sights, sounds, and tastes of one of the most intriguing and exotic countries in South America, Peru. In the cosmopolitan capital Lima they explore the traditional Lima, the amazing cuisines that Lima is famous for and the music of a Peruvian legend. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2024.03.26 TUE 10:30pm.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.desc: 嘉賓主持阿爾瓦羅帶雅各深入帕拉卡斯沙漠，追踪納斯卡線，發掘非裔秘魯音樂的根源，又越過秘魯版本嘅加拉巴哥群島，最後到達帕拉卡斯沙漠柔軟潔白的沙丘。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年3月26日 星期二晚，10時30分 . 秘魯 - 帕拉卡斯 (4K). Co-Host Alvaro takes Jacob into the desert of Paracas to follow the Nazca lines, explore the origins of afro-peruvian music, across the Peruvian Gallapagos and to finally explore the soft white sand dunes of Paracas. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2024.03.26 TUE 10:30pm.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: The Health Bureau recently announced a reform of public healthcare charges, restructuring the subsidy framework for public medical services. The reform aims to guide citizens in the proper use of healthcare resources, reduce waste and misuse, and comprehensively strengthen medical protection for patients who are disadvantaged, urgent, critical, or in danger. This initiative seeks to enhance the sustainability of the healthcare system and reinforce the public healthcare sector in addressing challenges such as population ageing and medical inflation. How do different sectors view this reform? And do citizens have a comprehensive and clear understanding of it.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 感激有你
programme.sub-title: 感激有你 - 區區有愛
programme.desc: 幫助獨居長者換燈膽、替行動不便的街坊取藥、教婆婆用手機與孫仔視像通話. . . .這些點點滴滴的舉手之勞，對有需要的街坊來說，就是生活上的及時雨。當打風落雨、突發事故，他們更會即時化身「社區第一防線」，為街坊解決困難，他們就是由義工組成的社區關愛隊；他們用腳行遍社區，用眼觀察需要，進駐18區的每個角落，當街坊有需要的時候，他們就會出動。今集主持會帶大家去了解屯門友愛邨關愛隊的日常工作情況.

programme.title: 香港故事：情繫香港
programme.desc: Yoga and Bollywood, these two very different Indian cultures are slowly developing in Hong Kong. The Indian population has been making a living from business in Hong Kong for some time. Many of the young Indians who have been engaged in cultural endeavours in Hong Kong are the new generation of Indians who came to Hong Kong from India after the handover. . Bilingual: English / Cantonese (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2024.05.17 FRI 10:30pm / RTHK32.

programme.title: 縣委大院
programme.desc: 需要關停的污染企業背景複雜，梅曉歌讓環保局局長不管其背景，一律做關停處理。梅曉歌去見在原平鄉發展蔬菜種植的前任縣長，與他探討農業發展的新出路。梅曉歌在市里的會議上被批評光明縣經濟排名下降，招商不力。因為堅守環保紅線，梅曉歌跟艾鮮枝都面臨著巨大的壓力.

programme.title: 縣委大院
programme.desc: 梅曉歌認為發展農業是給光明縣工業兩極分化以後的弱勢者找出路，這項工作的意義並不比發展工業和招商差。他下令在原平鄉和鹿泉鄉搞農業發展試點，並與艾鮮枝一起帶領土地流轉領導小組。林志為向梅曉歌反應村民對於土地流轉沒有安全感，因此持觀望態度.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：泛亞交響樂團 凌顯祐．新世界
programme.sub-title: 泛亞交響樂團 凌顯祐．新世界
programme.desc: 泛亞交響樂團成立接近五十年，創辦人葉惠康博士一直擔任樂團音樂總監及指揮，以推廣音樂給市民大眾為理念，演出逾幾百場音樂會。《演藝盛薈．開放舞台：泛亞交響樂團凌顯祐．新世界》其實是年逾九十的葉博士交棒予新任樂團音樂總監凌顯祐的莊嚴儀式。葉、凌二人在台上分享了他們的深厚情感，觀眾無不動容。. 音樂會上半場，凌顯祐邀請了兩位他在香港管弦樂團的同袍–單簧管首席史安祖、及低音單簧管手艾爾高演出，兩位樂手在樂曲的表現上發揮高超的技巧而充滿玩味感。音樂會的標題「凌顯祐‧新世界」與下半場樂團演出的德伏扎克E小調第九交響曲，又名「新世界交響曲」，兩者互相呼應，觀眾可見證新總監凌顯祐如何傳承葉博士的音樂理念，帶領樂團提升到另一新境界。音樂會片段由泛亞交響樂團攝製及提供。. 曲目：. 1.龐吉耶利：單簧管二重奏及樂隊的作品. 2.孟德爾遜：為單簧管，巴塞管及樂隊而寫的音樂會作品第一首. 3.德伏扎克：E小調第九交響曲，「新世界.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 荔枝窝位于新界东北，当中的客家村已经有超过300年历史，是香港最古旧、最大规模，和保存得最好的农村之一。不过荔枝窝曾经随着香港农业息微而凋零。直至十年前，一班有心复村的人开展了「永续荔枝窝」计划，进行一连串农地复耕、社区活化等活动，吸引到包括原居民和对耕作有兴趣的人，重临这片土地。. 另外，经过生态学家的努力，几乎在荔枝窝绝迹的米鱼亦都成功被培育，令到荔枝窝再次充满生机.

programme.title: 體壇無界限
programme.desc: 甲一組籃球聯賽季後賽正式展開。另外會繼續跟進西甲籃的戰況。還有國際乒乓球聯盟亞洲盃、馬術及馬拉松等賽事的精華片段.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 感激有你
programme.sub-title: 感激有你 - 香港守望者服務團
programme.desc: 香港守望者服務團成立了四年，團員已經超過30人，來自各行各業的他們，雖然大多數是全職上班族，但卻願意在工作之餘投入這份無償的搜救工作。創辦人鄭偉軒相信，除了政府救援部門，民間也應該有一支專業且靈活的隊伍，能夠在最短的時間內投入搜救行動，為遇險者爭取寶貴的時間。鄭偉軒分享多年來在搜救過程中見證的人性光輝，感嘆強頑的生命力.

programme.title: 周末大電影：相中情書
programme.desc: 出身鄉村的街頭攝影師為了替家人還債，每天在孟買的旅遊景點替遊客拍照。因為年邁的祖母希望能見到他成家立室，他找了一位年輕女客人的照片來充當未婚妻。但祖母突然要到孟買登門造訪，嚇得他措手不及。為令祖母安心，他唯有找出相中女孩，游說她扮演其未婚妻。家境優渥的女孩原本靜待畢業後，接受家人安排的婚事，但她一時衝動下答應了攝影師的請求，令她平平無奇的人生泛起漣漪。兩個來自不同階層的陌生人，因了解而建立了微妙的關係….

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 將廣闊國土上的陽光、勁風與江河之力轉化為驅動未來的綠色動能，用沙漠陽光點亮萬家燈火，讓工廠流淌綠色電流。當「啟航號」風車的巨臂劃破長空，捕獲大自然之力，加上「零碳」工廠在黑暗中高效運轉，我們看見清潔能源正在重塑中國製造的基因.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 釗彤、張進翹(Manson)兩位俊男美女攜手合作虐心情歌《想找到對的人》，二人首次合作，便恍若「找到對的人」，一拍即合！今集我們會邀請他們細說合作的緣起，以及期間發生的趣事。. 主持. 崔潔彤、黃明德. 歌曲：. 《想找到對的人》. 《世界上最爛的人》. 《自我反省.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: 本輯透過僱主、殘疾員工及其工作伙伴、顧客等的互動與經驗分享，從多角度呈現共融職場，了解他們的關愛勵志故事，以鼓勵及吸引更多僱主聘請殘疾員工，促進殘疾人士就業，實現共融社會。. 今集，這間物管公司十年前已開始為傷殘同事提供工作機會。本集拍攝該部門如何透過不同方式，包括師徒制來督導和支援殘疾員工。同時，公司帶領義工同事參與傷殘共融活動，讓其他同事接觸殘疾人士，達成職場共融的目標.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
31看世界 - 魅力阿聯酋
programme.sub-title: 第二集：多元化的繽紛魅力
programme.desc: 因為得天獨厚的地理位置，阿聯酋在歷史上始終與世界保持著貿易往來。今天，它與全球的聯繫更日益緊密。. 隨著阿聯酋航空業的發展，越來越多的外籍人士來到阿聯酋生活，多元文化在此彙聚。法國之外的全球唯一一所盧浮宮博物館帶來了頂級文化盛宴，F1大獎賽等世界級體育賽事讓這裡充滿速度與激情。. 引入機器人騎手參賽的駱駝比賽，充滿包容性的傳統樂器烏德琴，使阿聯酋在擁抱全球多元文化的同時，始終傳承著自己的文化根基。. 中阿兩國在歷史上就已經開始交往，如今，在兩國建交40周年之際，兩國合作項目如雨後春筍般湧現。在密切的交流合作中，中國和阿聯酋正攜手開創全新的未來.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 感激有你
programme.sub-title: 感激有你 - 香港守望者服務團
programme.desc: 香港守望者服務團成立了四年，團員已經超過30人，來自各行各業的他們，雖然大多數是全職上班族，但卻願意在工作之餘投入這份無償的搜救工作。創辦人鄭偉軒相信，除了政府救援部門，民間也應該有一支專業且靈活的隊伍，能夠在最短的時間內投入搜救行動，為遇險者爭取寶貴的時間。鄭偉軒分享多年來在搜救過程中見證的人性光輝，感嘆強頑的生命力.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第十九集：陳行遠、祝豐山辭職
programme.desc: 邢禮和陳行遠一起吃飯，兩人笑裡藏刀。邢禮最終主動示弱，暗示邱老打算讓陳行遠接替他的職位，請求陳行遠在汶琥集團案件上收，陳行遠卻不接受，鐵定了要離開聯眾，創辦自己的銀行。集團大會上，宣佈了陳行遠、祝豐山辭職的事件，邢禮安排心腹頂替他們的位置.

programme.title: 前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第二十集：林強接替陳行遠的位置
programme.desc: 看守所裡，錢才拜託律師給弟弟帶話，暗示他好自為之。錢渤非常生氣，認為哥哥阻礙他往上爬，不願伸出援手。總行風雨飄搖，越來越多的人遞交了辭呈。邱老提議讓林強接替陳行遠的位置，邢禮權衡利弊之後，同意林強上位。林強想到了一個大膽的計畫，要跟邢禮抗衡.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2 - 回歸森林
programme.desc: 當年邁的「公雞甲蟲」年華老去，再也無法啼唱時，所有人都為毛毛感到憂心忡忡。「公雞」是毛毛最親密的夥伴。儘管他嘴上總說著「我沒事」，卻掩飾不了內心的悲傷。看著故作堅強的他，菇菇們決定伸出援手，讓他明白：流露真情實感，並不是軟弱的表現.

programme.title: 紅粉緋緋與彼得叻叻豬
programme.sub-title: (A) 喜悅的跳躍 (B) 紅粉鳳凰
programme.desc: A)彼得認為他太矮小，玩一些有趣活動時及不上緋緋和華仔，所以緋緋為他製造了一雙可以跳得很高的鞋子！但彼得和緋緋要學會穿上這雙鞋之後如何彈跳，否則可能趕不及到達球場參加籃球比賽。. B)緋緋看到一隻紅粉鳳凰。紅粉村已經53年未有人看見過這種非常罕有的雀鳥！所有人都很想看看紅粉鳳凰，緋緋、彼得、華仔和莉莉出發去尋找牠。！. 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2021年5月16日 星期日 上午9時00分 (重播) 2021年5月16日 星期日 下午6時30分 (重播) 2021年5月22日 星期六 下午6時30分 (網上重溫) 至 2022年5月15日 星期日 . A)Peter thinks he’s too short to do fun activities as well as Pinkalicious or Rafael, so he makes shoes that let you jump really high! But he and Pinkalicious will need to learn how to jump properly if they’re going to make it to the park in time to play basketball. . B) Pinkalicious sees a pinkatoo, a rare music-loving bird that hasn’t been seen in Pinkville for 53 years! Now everyone wants to see the pinkatoo, too. Pinkalicious, Peter, Rafael and Jasmine set out to find that bird!. Channel: RTHK 31 Time: (First Run) 2021.5.16 SUN 9:00am (Re-run) 2021.5.16 SUN 6:30pm (Re-run) 2021.5.22 SAT 6:30pm (On-line Catch-up) Till 2022.5.15 SUN.

programme.title: 時光正好
programme.sub-title: 第二十八集：婉真被造謠
programme.desc: 婉真負責的母嬰業務贏得開門紅，周耀正要為她開慶功宴，婉真卻遭到異樣的眼光。原來是錢副總把她離婚和弟弟相戀的事做成傳單四處散發。周耀問清此事後，決定出手幫她，把造謠的人告到底.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 黎海婷熱愛舞蹈，從小學習拉丁舞和標準舞，目標成為一位出色的舞蹈老師，但她有讀寫障礙，專注力不足令她在學習上遇到不少困難。. 但這沒有影響她在舞蹈方面成績彪炳，她鍾情於拉丁舞，源於父母都是拉丁舞高手，從小跟父母學習拉丁舞，亦參加本地及海外的拉丁舞比賽，獲得獎項及卓越成績。為求不斷進步，她會前往海外進修以及跟隨不同老師學習拉丁舞，學習障礙並沒有阻礙她，她更努力及花更多時間練習。. 今集主持Marco吳祉昊會大展舞藝，和天生識跳舞、來自哥倫比亞的Carmen 一同在舞池與海婷翩翩起舞.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第八集：官司情況對羅英子不利
programme.desc: 羅英子向王大福詢問了關於死者秦愛蓮生前的事，在得知秦愛蓮還有一個相好之後，她把這個消息分享給了陳碩，陳碩借機請羅英子吃飯。此時，邱華通知英子有關劉銘公司的法定代表人早前已轉移成她，情況對她非常不利，方麗虹建議她要找到劉銘來當面處理事情.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 尾巴會說話
programme.desc: 一匹馬，一個團隊，共同創造一代傳奇，寫下一個關於夢想和堅持的故事。. 現年八歲的「浪漫勇士」——牠用速度寫下國際賽馬歷史，打破多項香港紀錄，成為全球贏得最多獎金的賽駒。牠在澳洲、日本、中東及英國等地贏出重要賽事，然而，牠的成功，從不只是一匹賽馬的故事。. 從馬主劉柏輝在拍賣會上的決定，到練馬師沈集成的精心雕琢，到全球最佳騎師之一麥道朗與牠並肩出戰呈現人馬合一的精神，每一個人，都用專業與熱愛，陪牠走過邁向馬王的每一步。. 2025年年中，浪漫勇士診斷出左前球節受傷，並接受手術將螺絲植入左前腿，休養半年後重新出戰，再創歷史。. 這不只是一部關於香港馬王的紀錄片，而是關於信任、堅持，以及人與動物之間的戰友情。凌晨的晨操、賽前的默契、慶功時的歡樂、還有對退役生活的規劃——一切都在引證：真正的傳奇，是一個團隊用心築夢的故事。. 本片將會走進「浪漫勇士」的世界，感受馬蹄踏出的溫度，見證一代戰駒如何成為時代傳奇，以及在這段旅程中，所有人如何被彼此改變、成就彼此.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 未來方案
programme.desc: 新的未來要求我們改變生活方式和地點，從智慧城市和捕獲二氧化碳，以至重新野化地球，本集將探索人類如何重新設計、恢復和再生未來的地球。 建立花園城市、海綿城市、轉廢為能、復原紅樹林，甚至把二氧化碳轉化為石頭，各地專家正發揮渾身解數，各施其技去保護人類的棲息地，讓我們可以像其他物種，在這片土地上泰然自若地生存及生活。 . 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年10月21日 星期一晚上10時30分.

programme.title: 體壇無界限
programme.desc: 甲一組籃球聯賽季後賽正式展開。另外會繼續跟進西甲籃的戰況。還有國際乒乓球聯盟亞洲盃、馬術及馬拉松等賽事的精華片段.

programme.title: 冰球少年
programme.desc: 陳徹得知沈舟舟服用的是治療焦慮症的藥物，陳徹反思，決定對沈舟舟更加關心與照顧。沈父因擔心沈舟舟的病情，向沈舟舟母親尋求幫助。陳徹去沈舟舟住的旅館勸他回家，沈舟舟不願回家。陳徹無奈把沈舟舟帶到寵物店居住。陳徹帶沈舟舟四處散心，向沈舟舟真誠道歉.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集: 林強重啟調查違規貸款
programme.desc: 林強上位後，決定繼續查汶琥集團和總行的的帳。邢禮只好去找邱之彰求情。誰知邱老對於邢禮解散監察部的行為耿耿於懷，不願再助紂為虐，決定召開董事會公開裁定邢禮的問題。邢禮的助理錢渤，為助邢禮，偽造陳行遠和汶琥集團的資金往來.

programme.title: 前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集: 陳行遠被拘留
programme.desc: 林強收到袁冠奎的通知，陳行遠被帶走了。錢渤作為董事長助理，要求聯眾銀行上上下下寫下有關陳行遠的自查自糾報告。林強在總行展開了大規模的查帳工作，把整個公司搞得雞犬不寧，最終找到了七家可疑的公司，並最終鎖定了一家境外銀行.

programme.title: 童真無國界
programme.desc: 馬素熱愛她爸爸阿里每晚講述的童話故事。一天，她無意中聽到了爸爸在工作上對人工智能的擔憂，開始將人工智能視為一種巨大的威脅。隨著在學校聽到的討論，她的擔憂愈加加劇。馬素試著操作電腦，但意識到自己無法超越人工智能。. 某晚，阿里因為工作無法講故事，馬素決定自己閱讀童話《阿拉丁》。由於沒有爸爸的陪伴而感到無聊，馬素於是開始玩平衡板，卻因不小心摔倒而進入了童話世界。在那裡，她與阿拉丁一起展開了一場漂浮在天空中的旅程。阿拉丁鼓勵她，幫助她在飛行地毯上保持平衡。這段旅程讓馬素明白，人類自古以來就是不斷地適應變化，這是一個如童話般古老，恒久不變的定律。. 在接下來的童話中，她又來到「阿里巴巴」的故事中，並意識到人們對未知事物的恐懼。隨著「玻璃鞋」的故事回到原本的狀態，最終，當馬素在床頭燈下聆聽父親的童話時，她明白了父親已經適應了工作和生活中的變化.

programme.title: 紅粉緋緋與彼得叻叻豬
programme.sub-title: (A) 紅粉腳板 (B) 青苔精靈絲絲
programme.desc: A)露營時，爸爸說了一個關於紅粉腳板的傳說故事：一隻粉紅色怪物，它的大腳板有七隻腳趾！緋緋和彼得卻竟然遇到了真的紅粉腳板，還了解到傳說故事可以跟現實截然不同。. 31看世界 - 大腦解碼
programme.desc: 物理學家占．艾爾─卡利里(Jim Al-Khalili)正致力破解一個跨越六億年的謎題：人類大腦究竟是如何進化而來。本集探討靈長類祖先進入森林後，大腦如何因應生存挑戰而進化——穿梭叢林、尋找食物、避開掠食者等等。然而真正的突破，來自大腦學會「社交」——我們天生能讀懂面孔、理解情緒、並協作共事。這種社交「超能力」開啟了人類智慧的進程。透過腦部掃描、化石發現與尖端研究，揭示了為何人類充滿情感、依賴社交的大腦如此難以模仿。從古老森林到現代實驗室，這是一段非凡的故事，講述我們如何成為今日這種能思考、能感受、能社交的生物.

programme.title: 怒放
programme.desc: 本集聚焦賽事選手背後以不屈赴夢，以熱血傳神的故事，走進全盲運動員楊曉婷、單腿球王何憶義、九金王蔣裕燕，以及新疆盲人足球隊等代表人物的世界。他們身殘志堅，不懼命運挑戰，以勇往直前的信念追逐夢想，用汗水澆築榮耀，生動詮釋「向陽而生」的力量，弘揚中華體育精神，讓每一份堅持都閃耀光芒。. 播映時間：2月3日星期二晚上8點.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 女團力量台上爆發！Honey Punch由音樂監製伍樂城親自挑選六位成員出道，以清純甜美、活力形象與觀眾見面，「甜蜜重擊」打入樂迷心裡面。她們年紀輕輕，要兼顧學業及演藝發展，如何取得平衡呢？今集她們除了分享入行點滴之外，亦會帶來兩首快歌。節目邀請了黃明德擔任嘉賓主持，同場加映他的新作，切勿錯過！. 主持：崔潔彤、黃明德(Dark). 歌曲：. 《蝶式》. 《滑到入心》. 《實現情緒自由.

programme.title: 守藝薪傳：名家導讀
programme.desc: 本集守藝薪傳名家導賞版，麥勁生教授將帶大家欣賞中國傳統文化：粵劇和揚琴。. 粵劇是融合南北藝術精華的傳統表演藝術，自明清時期的廣州發展至香港，成為人類非物質文化遺產。芳雪瑩從中學英文老師轉型為粵劇導師，專心培育後進，徒弟張雅泳五歲開始習藝，十歲即成文武生，多次獲獎，並致力於傳承粵劇。師徒兩代以粵劇藝術啟發年輕一代，開創香港粵劇的未來。. 揚琴是西方引入的民族樂器，在廣東音樂史上扮演重要角色。賴應斌六歲習琴，成為首位獲得揚琴演奏碩士的本土音樂家，對揚琴教育貢獻良多。徒弟蕭俊賢已獲音樂碩士，並組成樂團「伍人粵」，用創新手法延續廣東音樂的傳統.

programme.title: 科學．創未來 3 — Future Minds 未來科學大獎獲獎者圓桌對話
programme.sub-title: 科學．創未來 3 — Future Minds 未來科學大獎獲獎者圓桌對話
programme.desc: 十年樹木，百年樹人。踏入十周年的年度科學界盛會「未來科學大獎」，已於去年十月第三度在香港圓滿舉行。三項大獎——生命科學獎、物質科學獎、數學與計算機科學獎，分別由七位科學家獲得。. 為促進交流、互相啟迪，大獎一如往年舉辦圓桌論壇，邀請本屆五位得獎科學家——徐星教授、周忠和教授、戴希教授、丁洪教授、盧志遠教授，以及以及兩位往屆得獎者——莫毅明教授、許晨陽教授，共聚一堂，分享科研心得。論壇由大獎捐贈人之一王強先生擔任主持。. 七位科學家不僅以深入淺出的語言介紹古生物學、凝聚態物理學、非易失性存儲技術等領域的前沿發展，更分享了科研之路必經的三個階段：啟蒙時刻、確立目標、跌宕前行，娓娓道來當中的甘苦與感悟。最後，他們也對下一代科學家與未來科學發展作出期許。這是一場薈萃科學探索與人文哲思的思想盛宴.

programme.title: 童真無國界
programme.desc: 馬素熱愛她爸爸阿里每晚講述的童話故事。一天，她無意中聽到了爸爸在工作上對人工智能的擔憂，開始將人工智能視為一種巨大的威脅。隨著在學校聽到的討論，她的擔憂愈加加劇。馬素試著操作電腦，但意識到自己無法超越人工智能。. 某晚，阿里因為工作無法講故事，馬素決定自己閱讀童話《阿拉丁》。由於沒有爸爸的陪伴而感到無聊，馬素於是開始玩平衡板，卻因不小心摔倒而進入了童話世界。在那裡，她與阿拉丁一起展開了一場漂浮在天空中的旅程。阿拉丁鼓勵她，幫助她在飛行地毯上保持平衡。這段旅程讓馬素明白，人類自古以來就是不斷地適應變化，這是一個如童話般古老，恒久不變的定律。. 在接下來的童話中，她又來到「阿里巴巴」的故事中，並意識到人們對未知事物的恐懼。隨著「玻璃鞋」的故事回到原本的狀態，最終，當馬素在床頭燈下聆聽父親的童話時，她明白了父親已經適應了工作和生活中的變化.
