programme.desc: 過去九年，Mark Palm一直為巴布亞新畿內亞的塞皮克區提供免費航空服務，這位44歲的加州機師駕駛著水上飛機運送傷者，協助被蛇咬、被鱷魚襲擊、身陷瘧疾、分娩遇到困難的人。他也會為當地居民收集及派發藥物，安排疫苗接種及爭取醫療福利。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2023年11月27日 星期一晚上10時30分 For 9 years, Mark Palm has been helping residents of the Sepik River villages, one of the most remote areas of Papua New Guinea, free of charge. Snake bites, crocodile attacks, malaria crisis’s, difficult childbirths, the life of this 44-year-old Californian is a succession of adventures. Onboard his seaplane plane, he transports the wounded, brings medicine, and organizes vaccination campaigns for the 200 000 Papuans who live along the river, often in difficult conditions. programme.title: 香港故事：邊境人家
programme.sub-title: Nam Chung: LOHAS around the border
programme.desc: Straight roads, rolling hills, and tranquil fishponds define Nam Chung, a 300-year-old Hakka village south of Sha Tau Kok. Home to five clans, it is led by young village head Chan Sai-leong, who carries his father’s legacy by overseeing an eight-year restoration of the Nam Chung Hip Tin Temple. This sacred space now serves as a hub for worship, arbitration, and community bonding. Former university professor Chan Shun-hing, a decade-long advocate for Nam Chung’s ecological revival, relocated to live sustainably with the Reed Blossom Eco-Education Fund. Through seven years of oral history, she weaves herself into the community. In this verdant haven, each resident builds their own paradise.

programme.sub-title: 第952集 透過惜食平台，市民同商戶可以點樣參與減少食物浪費呢？
programme.desc: 「生蠔食物中毒．感染諾如病毒」. 最近接連發生食物中毒個案，中毒群組懷疑進食咗受污染嘅生蠔，而感染諾如病毒。到底生蠔與諾如病毒有何關係？市民又如何預防感染？ . #食物中毒#生蠔#諾如病毒#感染#預防#余詠茵. 「善用惜食App．減廢你至叻」. 香港食物浪費問題一直備受關注，有惜食平台就透過與餐廳、連鎖麵包店、酒店等等合作，把過剩食品以折扣價出售，既助商家減少損失，亦讓消費者以更低價格獲得高品質食品。減少剩食浪費之餘，更提升公眾惜食與環保意識。. #食物#浪費#惜食#過剩食品#環保#黃婉曼#崔潔彤. 「銀髮有辦法-長者送暖」. 農曆新年將至，有機構提供「電器贈長者計劃」，藉佳節為長者送暖，安排義工到訪獨居及雙老長者，送上家電及禦寒物。這個計劃不論義工或接受服務的人士都是長者，期望以老護老，互相扶持。 . #銀髮有辦法#電器#長者#轉贈#義工#梁峻文. 「童話香港-你認識這些粵語詞語嗎？」. 粵語又稱白話，保留了一定的古漢語用詞。當中有許多說話時常用，但書寫上郤少見。小朋友們又懂多少？ . #童話香港#小朋友#粵語#古漢語#香港道教聯合會雲泉學校.

programme.title: 31看世界 -惜食料理大師班
programme.desc: Studies have shown that carbohydrates like rice, bread and noodles are the most widely discarded food group in Singapore. Whether we eat at home or dine out, carbs have long been taken for granted as ‘cheap fillers’. Our two zero waste newbies, Melissa and Benji, also have this careless attitude, so host Isaac decides to get them toiling at a mini rice field – right here in Singapore!. With a newfound respect for the resources and effort it takes to grow a single grain of rice, Melissa and Benji head to the kitchen to learn ways to transform leftover carbs. They cap off their learning journey with a unique cook-off – utilising as many types of stale carbohydrates as they can! What kind of new life can they breathe into these previously unloved staples.

programme.title: 31看世界 -惜食料理大師班
programme.desc: From use-by to best before, 80% of Singaporeans are confused by the terms printed on their food labels. What do these labels mean? And what happens if the product is past its expiry date? A typical household in Singapore throws away an average of 19.6kg of expired food every year. But does all of it have to be thrown away? . Join our two kitchen amateurs, Kelvin and Ridhwan, as they go on a zero-waste journey to uncover when expired foods should actually be discarded. With the guidance of Chef Isaac Henry, our boys will learn essential pantry management, how to decode printed labels, and even hacks on how to use expired foods in everyday cooking! . With hardly any cooking experience, how will Kelvin and Ridhwan fare in a zero waste cook-off against each other, using only expired goods.

programme.sub-title: 感激有你 - 區區有愛
programme.desc: 幫助獨居長者換燈膽、替行動不便的街坊取藥、教婆婆用手機與孫仔視像通話. . . .這些點點滴滴的舉手之勞，對有需要的街坊來說，就是生活上的及時雨。當打風落雨、突發事故，他們更會即時化身「社區第一防線」，為街坊解決困難，他們就是由義工組成的社區關愛隊；他們用腳行遍社區，用眼觀察需要，進駐18區的每個角落，當街坊有需要的時候，他們就會出動。今集主持會帶大家去了解屯門友愛邨關愛隊的日常工作情況.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: A Chinese Mainland tech firm has made a major AI breakthrough, energizing Hong Kong’s tech sector. The Hong Kong SAR government has been boosting local AI research, supporting the Hong Kong Generative AI Research and Development Center (HKGAI) founded by universities to develop generative AI and large language models using local data. . In the AI era, strengthening Hong Kong’s innovation competitiveness and getting the next generation to learn AI early are key trends. As AI moves from labs to classrooms, Hong Kong must turn “AI + Education” into a future competitive advantage.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: 本輯透過僱主、殘疾員工及其工作伙伴、顧客等的互動與經驗分享，從多角度呈現共融職場，了解他們的關愛勵志故事，以鼓勵及吸引更多僱主聘請殘疾員工，促進殘疾人士就業，實現共融社會。. 今集，這間物管公司十年前已開始為傷殘同事提供工作機會。本集拍攝該部門如何透過不同方式，包括師徒制來督導和支援殘疾員工。同時，公司帶領義工同事參與傷殘共融活動，讓其他同事接觸殘疾人士，達成職場共融的目標.

programme.title: 香港故事：邊境人家
programme.sub-title: San Tin: Fish Pond Farmer's Legacy
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, Professor Cheung Chin-hung from The Chinese University of Hong Kong wrote a book about fish industry. Today, he revisits the fish ponds of San Tin, Yuen Long, to meet with fish farmers Lai Loi-chau and Kwok Muk-tai. Through their personal stories, the program retraces the history and evolution of Hong Kong’s pond fish farming industry. Growing up helping his father run traditional gei wai (tidal fish ponds), Lai witnessed their transformation into modern fish ponds and took part in fisheries associations to support industry development. Kwok, inheriting his father's craft, remains committed to tradition—catching juvenile mullets by hand to preserve age-old methods. Through the vivid memories of these two fishermen, the program reflects on the glory days of local aquaculture and their enduring passion and dedication, reviving a heartfelt, human story of Hong Kong's fishing heritage.

programme.title: 家國萬里
programme.desc: From minority communities in Gansu to religious landmarks in Quanzhou, this episode highlights China’s embrace of multiple cultures and faiths, showcasing a civilization enriched by diversity and openness.
